segments.speaker: Rep. Patricia C. Calderon

Lazaro, Chief Coordinator Maria Antonina M. Mendoza-Oblena, Undersecretary Maria Theresa B. Dizon-De Vega, and Undersecretary Leo M. Herrera-Lim.

segments.speaker: Rep. Patricia C. Calderon
segments.text: Undersecretary Maria Andrelita S. Austria, OIC Undersecretary Ezadin H. [unclear], and the other assistant secretaries.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano

segments.speaker: Rep. Patricia C. Calderon
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to recognize Representative Sancho Fernando Oaminal of Misamis Occidental and Representative Niko Raul Daza of Northern Samar of the Committee on Appropriations to answer questions on the proposed budget of the Department of Foreign Affairs.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Vice Chair Sancho Fernando "Ando" Oaminal and Vice Chair Niko Raul Daza, you have the floor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleagues, ladies and gentlemen, please allow me to welcome to the House of Representatives the Department of Foreign Affairs, headed by Secretary Maria Theresa P. Lazaro, together with its attached agencies: the Foreign Service Institute, the Presidential Commission on Visiting Forces, and the UNESCO National Commission of the Philippines. It is my honor, together with my colleague Representative Niko Raul Daza, to sponsor

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: the DFA's proposed budget for fiscal year 2027 in the amount of approximately 35.17 billion. This represents a 21.77% increase from the fiscal year 2026 GAA and will support the department's work in national security, economic diplomacy, consular services, assistance to Filipinos overseas, and organizational development. Fellow

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: members of Congress, the Department of Foreign Affairs plays a central role in advancing and protecting Philippine interests abroad. Its work remains anchored on the three pillars of Philippine foreign policy: preservation and enhancement of national security, promotion and attainment of economic security, and protection of the rights and promotion of the welfare and interests of Filipinos overseas. This year the Philippines has taken on a major regional responsibility as chair of ASEAN

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: under the theme "Navigating Our Future, Together." Through our chairship, the Philippines has helped advance key regional priorities and would have hosted more than 640 meetings throughout the year at the leaders', ministerial, officials' and technical levels. A key outcome of the May 2026 summit in Cebu is the ASEAN Leaders' Declaration on Maritime Cooperation, which provides for

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: the establishment of the ASEAN Maritime Center to be hosted by the Philippines. Beyond ASEAN, the department continues to strengthen the Philippines' bilateral and multilateral partnerships in pursuit of mutually beneficial cooperation. These engagements serve to build and strengthen alliances and partnerships, promote Philippine economic interests, particularly trade and investment, and strengthen people-to-people ties. Maritime security remains a major foreign policy priority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: This year marked the tenth anniversary of the 2016 arbitral award. The 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea and the 2016 award remain the twin anchors of our foreign policy in the maritime space as we protect and promote our sovereignty, sovereign rights and jurisdiction in the West Philippine Sea. Mr. Speaker, service to our Filipinos overseas remains at the core of the department's work. This

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: responsibility has become even more important amid continuing conflict in the Middle East.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: The DFA, through our foreign service posts, continues to assist Filipinos affected by hostilities

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: and coordinates closely with the Department of Migrant Workers and other partner agencies

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: on repatriation and other forms of assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: The Department continues its diplomatic engagements with governments and international organizations

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: to help safeguard Filipino seafarers and Philippine-flagged vessels

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: operating in areas affected by conflict and heightened security risks.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: These efforts underscore the need for the Department to maintain the capability to respond quickly

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: whenever the safety and welfare of Filipinos overseas are at risk.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: The DFA likewise continues to work closely with the Department of Migrant Workers

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: In countries without a resident migrant workers' office,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: the DFA continues to play a lead role in looking after our Kababayans.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: The Department also remains responsible for overseas Filipinos

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: who are not classified as migrant workers,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: including students, tourists, permanent residents, and other Filipino nationals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: At the same time, the Department continues to bring consular services closer to the public.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: In 2026, the DFA processed more than 1.5 million passports,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: and continued to provide services through its 42 consular offices nationwide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: The 2027 budget will support preparations for the next-generation Philippine passport,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: which is expected to feature enhanced security features,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: and an option for additional passport pages.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: It will likewise support continued investments in ICT,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: The DFA is also expanding the reach of the Foreign Service

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: through the opening of new posts in strategic locations,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: including our embassies in Accra, Ghana, and Astana, Kazakhstan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: which are expected to open this year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: and our Consulate General in Miami, Florida,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: These posts will help bring services closer to Filipino communities abroad

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: while strengthening the country's political and economic engagement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: the DFA's proposed fiscal year 2027 budget will support its core operations

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: and respond to the Philippines' growing requirements in national security,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Given the Department's important role in advancing Philippine interests on the global stage,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: I respectfully urge this House to support the DFA's mission to improve the country's economic development,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: and provide the approval of the proposed

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: fiscal year 2027 budget of the Department of Foreign Affairs

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Salamat kay Cong Ando. Majority Leader.

segments.text: to interpolate the sponsor and the proposed budget of the Department of Foreign Affairs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. May the good gentleman, the good sponsor, yield some questions from this representation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Good morning, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Let me start by returning to the previous discussions during the committee briefings that DFA reported then that 44.5 million had been appropriated for online voting and overseas voter registration information campaigns.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Yet, records would show that turnout remains low during recent years.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: May I know what's the reason behind?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How come the turnout remains so low from previous years?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, maraming factors to consider bakit medyo mababa yung turnout.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And a few of which are the mobility of overseas Filipinos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Minsan, hindi po pinapayagan ng mga employees nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Political engagement or lack of confidence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And we have a limited awareness of the registration and the process.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yung iba po nating kababayan, hirap po sila to participate kasi hindi po nila alam yung how to go about it and how to participate in the electoral procedure, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, this is your sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Can you elaborate what does it mean?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: When I say lack of confidence po, Mr. Speaker, ibig sabihin po, yung mga workers po, they are not that confident yet in the process by which the elections is being done.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: They need more awareness, Mr. Speaker, kaya po yung Department of Foreign Affairs are consistently undergoing trainings and information campaigns to educate better these intended participants of the electoral process, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So in short, the lack of confidence, when you translate that to Tagalog, it means wala silang tiwala? Ganun ba yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So, it's not na wala po silang tiwala, Mr. Speaker, pero in a way din po, parang some of them feel that their votes do not necessarily make an impact, kaya hindi na lang po sila bumuboto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So they need more awareness and more information campaigns po, Mr. Speaker. Kumbaga, kailangan po ipaintindi po sa kanila na every vote counts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How much funds were allocated in the previous years for overseas absentee voting?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And in connection to that, could you explain the reasons for this low voter turnout and if this is isolated only in specific jurisdictions or is this prevalent in all countries where we have overseas voters?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, we are just gathering the data in terms of yung amount expended in the previous years.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: But for the turnout, it seems to be consistent in the different regions of the world.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Sa highest po is only 24.16%, which is in the Asia and the Pacific, and the lowest is in North and Latin Americas, which is 7.9%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And as I've mentioned earlier, Mr. Speaker, maraming factors po ang nag-contribute due to the low turnout.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: But the department is already doubling its efforts, ensuring that in the next electoral process, this will greatly improve, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Have you tried the COMLEC na magkaroon kayo ng consultation or technical working group when it comes to this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: At least, are they involved, COMLEC?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yes, definitely, Mr. Speaker. The COMLEC is very much involved in this procedure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: My follow-up question, just to put this in context, how many overseas registered voters do we have in 2025, if we have the figures on hand?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: As of 2025, Mr. Speaker, there are 1,241,690 registered overseas voters, to be exact po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Out of this 1.2 million voters, how many had actually voted?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Out of the 1.2 million po, Mr. Speaker, 228,000 approximately were able to actually vote, which is equivalent to 18.4%, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, napakababa pala ng turnout natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, ano sa tingin mo ang reason neto?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Lack of confidence, kailangan you have a massive information campaign.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Internet voting removed the physical distance problem, but turnout was still only about 18% among OBCS voters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, what does DFA's post-election assessment say?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Were the actual barriers pre-voting enrollment, digital literacy, authentication, awareness, trust, connectivity, or something else?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Yung mga kababayan ba natin, natatakot sila because they're not documented?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Several factors mentioned by the good gentleman, Mr. Speaker, contributed po dun sa low turnout.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And yung digital literacy is very important din po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Isa yun sa malaking reason bakit po hindi nakaboto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Nakaboto yung iba nating kababayan kahit na gusto po nilang bumoto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And that is why in the past several months and in the upcoming months, nagkaroon at magkakaroon po yung DFA ng overseas regional training for continuing overseas voter registration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Kasama na din po dyan yung process by which on how to exercise their vote, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I understand that statutory division of responsibility, but DFA operates the foreign service post and undertook information registration activities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I therefore want DFA's own expenditures and outputs separated from COMELEC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Besides, Mr. Speaker, overseas registration for the succeeding election cycle,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: already began on December 1, 2025, and is scheduled to continue through September 30, 2027 at embassies and consulates.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So I presume we'll be funding these activities again. Am I right?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker. Nakahiwalay po talaga yung budget ng overseas voting under the DFA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: For 2026, nagkaroon po ng 44.4 million separately.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And iba din po yung budget allocated by the COMELEC, which I do not have any record for.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: This office does not have any record.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So yung sa COMELEC, so you have separate budget with COMELEC. Am I right?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mga mamiya, nag-fund kayo, ganun din sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So there will be a separate, may kanya-kanya, baka yung jurisdiction, or how to go.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, as to the details of the budget, kasi part of which is the traveling expenses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So yung mga officials po ng COMELEC, dun po nila sinacharge sa office nila sa DFA naman po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Dito naman po under the DFA training expenses din po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Training of, there's a counterpart of DFA and there's a counterpart of COMELEC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So we assure the good gentleman that there is no duplicity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, before we fund further preparatory activity in 2027,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: when will Congress receive the costed proposal for the hybrid or revised overseas voting system,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: I'm sorry, may we repeat the question, Mr. Speaker?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Again, before we fund further preparatory activity for 2027, right now, because asking for another fund for 2027 here in Congress,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: kailan namin matatanggap yung costed proposal for the hybrid or revised overseas voting system,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kailan namin matatanggap yung lessons learned from 2025?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Remember 2025, the turnout was only around 18%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So ngayon, 2027, yung costing nyo for the preparation for the hybrid or revised overseas voting system.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So anong gagawin natin na hindi natin maulit yung turnout natin na 18%?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Part po ng activities that the DFA will conduct is yung training and information dissemination po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So yung pagpapaintindi po sa ating mga kababayan, how important their vote is.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So yun po yung nagdodouble efforts yung DFA and of course in partnership with COMELEC to educate our mga kababayan overseas po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yun po yung way na ma-increase po yung turnout natin, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And of course, better accessibility to the information needed through postings not only sa consular offices,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: I mean sa foreign posts offices, but also through the direct communication with our recorded kababayans, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: As you know, Mr. Speaker, 2288 is around...

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So do you think the 18% will translate maybe half, maybe 50% kaya ba natin by 2028?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Otherwise, Mr. Speaker, sayang lang yung pondong ibinibigay natin because we're funding our massive information campaign for our kababayan overseas to make sure na makaboto sila because every vote counts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So do you see in the 20...

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Or maybe the presidential election, tataas ang ating turnout vote?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: That is the hope and the direction, Mr. Speaker, na mapapataas po yung rate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And of course, we also are expecting that the COMELEC will double its efforts in increasing the turnout rate, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: But as far as the DFA is concerned...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: In coordinating with the overseas Filipino voters, so they're doubling their efforts already po, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you for that, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, may I go to one of the crucial mandates of the department?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, can you confirm the report that DFA had already lodged 39 diplomatic protests against China in 2026?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yes, that is correct, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The diplomacy program itself is seeking approximately 14.48 billion in 2027. Is this correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: For the next fiscal year, or maybe for the past years, what performance framework does DFA use to determine...

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: ...whether these protests are producing the intended diplomatic outcome?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, we believe that these diplomatic protests, since these are legal documents, have in a way toned down the aggression of other countries against the Philippines, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Makikita naman po natin na yung DFA, it is their role...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: ...is to diplomatically negotiate and communicate with other countries, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So, as we see na ngayon, while tensions are still there, pero medyo in a controlled level na po, then that is already an achievement on the part of the DFA, Mr. Chair, na yung mga inisyo na diplomatic notes are effective.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And in fact, many of which have been answered by China, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yung iba, maramihan po nila sinagot. Yung iba po, isa-isa nila sinagot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Is DFA tracking, for example, whether a protest receives a formal response, whether the complaint of conduct ceases or recurs, whether partner governments...

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: ...issues, supporting statements, whether operational behavior at sea changes, otherwise our protest will just be a mere formality with no outcome?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: As mentioned, Mr. Chair, there is no one-on-one, one-to-one correspondence on our protests with China.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yung reply nila, minsan, there are three or four diplomatic notes and they will only reply with one...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: They will reply to that once, yung three or four diplomatic notes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And we can see now, Mr. Chair, humuhupuan naman po yung tensyon as far as yung mga naririnig natin sa news before na there's attack against our fishermen, against our Coast Guard.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So ngayon, we are seeing na medyo nagto-tone down po, Mr. Chair, and we believe that this is greatly due also to the diplomatic notes issue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: by the Department of Foreign Affairs, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: This becomes more relevant because on September 11, following a Philippine Coast Guard report that Chinese forces fired flares toward a Philippine aircraft near Zamora, Subi, and Panganiban Mischief Reefs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The FBI public called on China to cease its activities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: at the futures and reiterated its position under UNCLOS and the 2016 Arbitral Award.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So with respect to the September flare incident, did DFA lodge a diplomatic protest?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Chair, the DFA is about to send a diplomatic protest on that particular attack, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, it happened last week, September 11.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, isn't it after the incident, the following day, we should launch a protest?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Hindi ba ganun ang SOP natin dyan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Because the DFA awaits the detailed incident report about the attacks before they send out a diplomatic protest, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So, we're just going to wait.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So, in short, we are about to send one already, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, are we expecting this week or next week?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Once the complete report has been submitted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Once the complete report has been submitted to the office already, Mr. Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: then immediately, that diplomatic note will be sent out.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I'll go to the funding for the Consular and Assistance to Nationals, yung tinatawag natin ATN program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Is it correct that the Consular and ATN program goes from approximately 7.47 billion in 2026

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What's this Assistance to Nationals program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: The Assistance to Nationals program, as for the Assistance to Nationals program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: there is a proposed funding for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And yet, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: in 2025, the program obligated 65% of its appropriations

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What exactly will an additional 6.6 billion purchase

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: that the department could not deliver with its previous budget?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Which line item will benefit from this increase?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Remember yung absorptive capacity nyo, utilization rate, mababa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and then you're asking for more?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: we are talking about the Assistance to Nationals program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, the Assistance to Nationals program

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: is like an insurance fund na gagamitin lang po kung kailangan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: It does not necessarily mean that if the proposed budget is

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: kailangan ubusin po yan on that fiscal year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Because it depends upon, it will depend upon the needs and the requests for assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So, masasabi po natin, the lower the rate of utilization,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: masasabi po natin, it's better for us kasi ibig sabihin lang po nun,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: konti lang po yung mga kababayan natin na nangangilangan ng tulong

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: and pumunta po sa atin, sa DFA, para humihingi po ng tulong, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, insured, Mr. Speaker, insured, that's part of insurance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker. It's like an insurance fund, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, you're asking for more because parang standby siya for insurance?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker. Kasi yung prior years po, mababalik na po sa National Treasury.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Okay. But, is it, I thought, yung 5.2 billion is increase in home office for MOOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Yun ba yun? So, it's not going to insurance?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, yung nire-request po ng DFA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: na ATN fund is around 1 billion annually and around 200 million for the Legal Assistance Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, how about MOOE nyo? Parang tumaas din ng 5.2 billion?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, yung sinasabi pong 5.8 billion budget is for the passport procurement and production, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, sponsor, could you explain the breakdown of the 13 billion, the share of passport, production, ordinary consular operations, ATN, legal assistance, reputation, ICT, and so on and so forth?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ano itong breakdown ng 13 billion? Just to be transparent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, ang tinatanong po ng Butihing Kalihim ay yung breakdown po ng 13.8 billion. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, 12.4 billion will go to the consular services, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So, kasama na po yan yung passport production,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: yung issuance of apostille certificates, among others, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: In relation to the budget of ATN,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: DFA explained in the previous committee briefing that part of the law ATN utilization is attributable to the creation of the Department of Migrant Workers

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and the transfer of OFW-related assistance functions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: That's correct, Mr. Speaker, kasi yung DMW po, na-devolved na po doon yung ATN funds for overseas Filipino workers or for OFWs po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: What remains under the umbrella of the DFA are overseas Filipinos who are not working abroad,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Students, dual citizens who in case of emergencies nangangailangan po ng tulong, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And also in some areas where there are no DMW satellite offices yet, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So yung DFA pa rin po yung tumutugon sa mga pangangailangan po ng mga OFWs in those particular areas, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ibang DMW natin sa mga consular natin o embassy, meron ba silang satellite office inside ng ano nyo o wala?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, hindi po lahat ng may DFA offices may DMW.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So as of now, there are only 48 DMW satellite offices, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ganun ba yun yung consular nyo? Ganun ba yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Or they have a office, small office inside your consular or your ano?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Marami po sa kanila, Mr. Speaker, are together inside the embassy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: But there are also areas where DMW is renting or leasing their offices outside po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Do you think that the law utilization because of overlapping, meron ba yung overlapping with DMW when it comes to ATN?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Overlapping in terms of yung line item but yung mga tao na kinikater, again, DMW caters to OFWs po, yung DFA, yung mga Filipinos who are overseas but are not necessarily workers and OFWs who are in areas without any DMW offices, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I have more few questions but because my time is winding down.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I just want to follow the strict rule of 30 minutes so this will be my last questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Recently, our good Secretary of Foreign Affairs, Guibo Chidoro, attended an international forum abroad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Siguro ay napanood na natin ito lahat because this becomes viral not only here but also internationally.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Sa video na ito, makikita natin na may nag-abot ng note habang si Secretary Guibo ay nagsasalita.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: At habang siya ay may sinasagot na tanong on stage, Secretary Guibo, upon reading the note, stopped mid-sentence at binasa niya ang nilalaman ng note na ito na nanggaling umano sa China, allegedly from China, Chinese Embassy representatives present in the forum.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: As we saw later in the photos, naglalaman ito ng pag-atake ng China sa 2016.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Inawag itong iligal at ang desisyon ng UNCLOS Arbitration Tribunal ay paglabag raw sa international law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Secretary Guibo called this stealthy passing of the note as actual coercion, bullying, and aggression, and a sign of disrespect towards South Korea as the host.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, this is your sponsor. May we ask the official position of the Department of Foreign Affairs on this incident?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, the Department of Foreign Affairs respects the statements and views of the good Secretary of the Department of National Defense.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: However, it maintains that it will continue to deal with these aggressions diplomatically, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, are you going to file also a protest or you will lodge a protest?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, hinihintay pa po ng opisina yung buong detalye po from the incident, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So eventually, are you going to lodge a protest?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: It will depend upon the evaluation po, Mr. Speaker, on our DFA officials.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: If it is necessary to issue a diplomatic...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: A diplomatic note on that matter, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So in short, yung evaluation nyo, is this an act of aggression yung ginawa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Because during a forum, may biglang aabot sa'yo, that's seldom, peculiar na makikita nyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So I think this is something that we have to file a protest, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: No less than, we were insulted, you know, because Secretaries, the alter ego of our President,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: But the DFA maintains its stand that differences in position are better addressed through established diplomatic channels

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: and in a manner consistent with the courtesy and professionalism expected in official international engagements, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. I have no more questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Patricia C. Calderon
segments.text: The sponsor, I move to recognize Representative Rene Luisco of Kabataan Partylist.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: The Honorable Rene Luisco is recognized to interpellate the sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And good morning to the distinguished sponsor and, of course, to the department.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: My first question is to clarify whether, to clarify the mandate of the DFA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Please correct me if I'm wrong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Tama po ba that the DFA...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: The DFA acts as the primary coordinator, advisor, and processing agency for the negotiation, ratification, and entry into force of treaties in the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: supposedly determining whether an international agreement qualifies as an executive agreement or a treaty requiring legislative concurrence

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: and drafting and coordinating closely with its offices on the drafts of the ratification of such treaties.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But may I request from the sponsor to clarify if this is accurate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, that is correct.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, I ask this because I'd like to clarify our commitments in relation to the Basel Convention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We ratified the Basel Convention already in 1993, a few years after we signed it in 1989.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: by the parties to the Basel

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ask for an update on the

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ratification of the Basel Ban Amendment?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: checking on the status of the

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: under the view of the DFA that this is under the Department of Environment and National Resources, Mr. Speaker?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yes, Madam Speaker. Mr. Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We also asked the DNR on the update on the ratification of the Basel ban amendment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: In 2020, they said it's in the works and six years later, this year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: we are given essentially the same update.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, given that there's almost no movement as to how we are compliant with this international agreement that we entered into,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: what can the DFA do to ensure that action and follow-through happens

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: so that this agreement has translation in ratification?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, upon checking, the DFA has ratified.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: The DFA has ratified the main agreement but not the protocols, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So, it is only the main agreement which is necessary to be ratified by the DFA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And the DFA will coordinate with the DNR as to the status of the protocols.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, to clarify, we're talking about the Basel ban amendment and this is separate from the convention?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Okay. Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, we'd like to request a report.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We'd like to request a report on how the DFA has ratified the Basel ban amendment already

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: and is waiting on the protocols which I understand is with the DNR. Is this correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, that is correct.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And the DFA would willingly submit a report to the Office of the Good Congressman whenever it is ready, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: defined, definitive update yet on the protocols.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: I raise this, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor because under the Basel Convention,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: which we already ratified and it's already enacted into law,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: state parties like the Philippines cannot trade waste with non-parties

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: unless there is a bilateral agreement with that non-party

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: which has terms and protections equal or better than that provided in the Basel Convention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And in the past year, however, there's been more than 250 shipments of electronic waste

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: from the United States imported by the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And the United States is a non-party to the Basel Convention which makes these imports illegal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co

segments.text: Sinusunod ng committee ang mga itinakdang pamantayan tulad ng creative merit, global appeal, at yung epekto po sa ating ekonomiya, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Madam Sponsor, mahalaga po ito dahil may mga filmmaker na mataas ang potensyal pero wala pang established track record.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Dapat malinaw kung paano po binabalanse ang quality, merit, experience, at pagkakataong makapasok ang bagong talento sa industriya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ang pangatlong katanungan ko naman po ay may kinalaman sa Create PH Films at pagpapalaki ng support sa filmmakers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor, ngayong 2026 ay pinalawak ng Film Development Council ang Create PH Films, kabilang ang pagsama ng animation at documentary projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Pagtaas ng maximum project development grant mula sa 300,000 pesos na naging 500,000 pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ang pagpapalawak ng production, funding, hanggang post-production sa 2027, paano po titiyakin ng Film Development Council na ang expanded assistance na ito ay tunay na nakakatulong sa filmmakers na makumpleto ang kanilang projects at hindi lamang nakatutok sa initial development.

segments.speaker: Rep. Lolita T. Javier
segments.text: Mr. Chair, through the Create PH Films funding program and in line with its mandate under Republic Act 9167, FTCP provides financial and logistical support across all stages of filmmaking development, production, post-production, marketing, distribution, exhibition, and production.

segments.speaker: Rep. Lolita T. Javier
segments.text: and archiving. Through this program, the government reinforces its commitment to nurturing quality Filipino films and promoting the growth of Philippine cinema. Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Madam Sponsor, follow-up questions lamang po. Ilang projects po ang target na masuportahan ng Create PH Films sa 2027 at ilan dito ang inaasahang matatapos at marirelease sa publiko?

segments.speaker: Rep. Lolita T. Javier
segments.text: Mr. Chair, it depends po sa quality, sa kalidad ng mga pelikula na naisasubmit po sa FTCP. Ang allocation po ng budget para sa mga programing ito ay 51 million, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor, pagdating po sa trabaho at kabuhayan sa film industry.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Ang film industry ay hindi lamang tungkol sa actors at directors. Kasama rito ang camera crew, editors, production staff, designers, technicians, writers, at iba pang workers na umasa sa regular na projects para sa kanilang kabuhayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Sa budget documents po, isa sa outcome indicators ng Film Development Council ay ang percentage increase sa film workers na nabigyan ng employment. Ano po ang kanilang methodology sa pagbilang ng film workers?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Na nabigyan ng employment? At ano po ang konkreto nitong programa upang magkaroon ng mas sustainable na trabaho at livelihood opportunities sa industriya?

segments.speaker: Rep. Lolita T. Javier
segments.text: Mr. Chair, hindi po sa cloud ng FTCP yung usapin na yan. Nasasakupan po yan ng Film Academy of the Philippines. Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Sponsor. Pagdating naman po sa Film Heritage Preservation, kanina po nabanggit po ninyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Nung 2027, target ay 1,320 films na evaluated at considered for restoration. 1,701 audiovisual elements to be managed and preserved. Ngunit isang film lamang ang target na ma-restore.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Nung 2025, isang film din ang aktual na na-restore. Ano po ang pangunahing constraint kung bakit isa lamang ang annual restoration target?

segments.speaker: Rep. Lolita T. Javier
segments.text: Mayroon po natin na sa nakaraang taon, wala pong budget na naibigay ang Kongreso sa Film Development Council of the Philippines sa restoration and archiving.

segments.speaker: Rep. Lolita T. Javier
segments.text: Kaya nga po sa panahon ito, sana po ay suportahan natin sila para naman po ay mapanood pa po ng ating mga future generation yung mga old movies natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Lolita T. Javier
segments.text: Yung mga ating mga anak ay makita pa rin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Lolita T. Javier
segments.text: At yung mga anak ay makita pa rin nila na maganda at kung gaano kadikalidad yung mga movies natin nung mga nakaraang panahon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Lolita T. Javier
segments.text: Kaya yun po yung number one actually na priority ng FDCP na magkaroon tayo ng mga suporta sa mga filmmakers at sa film archiving po. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Under current auditing guidelines, grant distributions are heavily reliant on tranche liquidations and post-expense reimbursements. Madali lang po 'yun for established production houses. Kaya po nilang i-outlay 'yung 500,000 to 1 million upfront while waiting for government tranche releases. 'Yun nga lang po, for young emerging independent storytellers without large capital reserves, this upfront expense requirement is a massive barrier to entry. Paano po ba, ano pong ginagawa ng FDCP upang ma-address itong cash flow bottleneck para ma-ensure na 'yung mga maaawardan ng grants hindi po maihinto sa early production dahil wala pong immediate operational capital? Ito po kasi 'yung kinonsulta natin sa ating mga young filmmakers na issue kung bakit hindi po sila makapagsimula in the first place.

segments.text: Sa pag-develop at pag-manufacture ng rocket, tama po ba?

segments.text: Okay. At tinatawag yung rocket, tinatawag na sounding rocket.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So pwede po bang mapaliwanag, ano yung sabihin ng sounding rocket?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: It will be a test launch, Mr. Speaker, but a sounding rocket can be used to

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: study weather and atmosphere conditions, radiation, space physics, communications, and new technologies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, so ang intindi ko po, yung sounding rocket, parang siyang mas maliit na rocket, mainly for research purposes, and sounding rockets are suborbital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Actually, hindi po pa aabot sa outer space technically, but its main use will be for research, scientific purposes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, so nasa ganung level po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So our concern po natin ay, okay, meron bang aspeto ng technology transfer at sinasabi, pag-develop ng industriya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang ayaw po natin mangyari, ito na naman, tag-assemble lang tayo, pero in the end, pag umalis yung kumpanya, in this case, Perigee, wala na naman tayong sariling industriya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano po ba ang perspektiba ng VILSA?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: As far as, at least as far as the Acting Director General is concerned, I had the opportunity to speak with her before this interpellation, Mr. Speaker, si Acting Director General Gay Jane P. Perez, physics professor po yan sa UP, at genuine rocket scientist.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ano po ba ang perspective ng VILSA?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, meron tayong technology transfer. In fact, meron na mga trainings ongoing ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: But the test launch shall be the next step in building capabilities that directly affect the country's economy, resilience, and long-term national interest.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Yung objective is not simply to launch a rocket, it is to build the people, technology, regulatory framework, safety procedure, and infrastructure

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: that will allow the people to be able to fly.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: that will allow the people to be able to fly.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: that will allow the people to be able to fly.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: That will allow the Philippines to develop its own launch capability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, allow the Philippines to develop its own launch capability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: We will pursue that a little bit, in a little bit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nabanggit nyo yung maliit na bahagi lang yung para sa launch.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Magkano po yung gagastusin for the launch?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: This year, Mr. Speaker, it will be a hundred million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: For this year. How about for next year?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: For next year, it will just be six million. Over six million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. So, one hundred million this year, and then six million next year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, the rest of the budget, nabanggit nyo po, will be for developing and launching another satellite.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Would you tell us more about this satellite? Mula?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Yes, it will be used in developing the Mula 2 satellite, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Yung Mula 2 satellite natin, isang multi-spectral unit for land assessment, satellite, earth observation satellite,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: being developed by FILSA to generate satellite data to benefit applications in agriculture, environmental protection and monitoring,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: natural resource management, disaster risk reduction, and national security, among others.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mula shall have a 5M multi-spectral imager, allowing the satellite...

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: to capture up to 139,000 square kilometers of satellite images per day.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: The development of Mula was started by DOST in 2021, and was continued in 2023 by FILSA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Thank you for that. So, mainly, imaging satellite, ganun po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At gagamitin para sa, among others, agrikultura?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: However, you did also mention national security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, baka pwede na nating isegway.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Could you just explain? Ano yung role sa national security?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: It is included in the Philippine Space Act, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. And as I understand, in the Philippine Space Council, ay co-chair po. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Is it DOST and BND Secretary?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Co-Vice Chair ang DOST, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: well, historically po, ang space sector, aerospace industry, including outer space,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: historically, magpipit na magkaugnay naman talaga yung militar at sibilyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At so, I suppose, kaya ganun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero ngayon, napapanahon, at in fact, sa gera,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang tinuturing na stratehikong lugar, ang kalawakan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, control of outer space means control of, I mean, you know,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: it's a requisite for control over everything below it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ngayon, ang tanong, dahil may national security aspect dito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: and development of certain advanced technologies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At ang pangunahing inisyatiba ng Malacanang,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ng Marcos Administration, kaugnay dyan ngayon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, may involvement ba ang FILSA at ang programa nila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang mga programa nila sa Pax Silica?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: dyan is the Defense Industrial Base of the United States.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And, inevitably, kasama doon, yung rockets, yung satellites,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, involved po ba ang FILSA sa Pax Silica?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, FILSA is not involved or connected with Pax Silica.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Or, will it never be involved?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: The agency has no knowledge about it, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: However, may lupa kayo sa New Clark City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And, in fact, yung lupa nyo ay gagamitin para sa Pax Silica.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kahit sa ganong level, ano po mangyayari sa inyong lupa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And, yet, you say you're not involved.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: The agency will relocate, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, gagamitin ang lupa nyo para sa Pax Silica sa New Clark City,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: BCDA will relocate the land, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Now, you also mentioned CESA earlier as involved in the rocket launch.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At sa kagayan magaganap yung launch.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In fact, saan po ang target ng first test launch ng sounding rocket

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung pinagmalaki ng Pangulo, saan mangyayari yung launch test?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: It will be in Cagayan, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Lalo Airport, which also happens to be an EDCA site.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Of all places in the Philippines, bakit po sa EDCA site gaganapin yung test launch?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Chair, because of the location, aside from the geographic advantages of being in

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: the country's eastern seaboard, Cagayan has existing infrastructure in place to execute the test launch of a sounding rocket.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Furthermore, the area has an institutional and economic zone framework administered by the Cagayan Economic Zone Authority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, dahil EDCA site po yan, obviously, nandyan po ang presensya ng U.S. military.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: By the U.S. military on a rotational basis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang alam po natin, yung mga helicopters ng U.S., yan ang ginagamit ng lunsaran.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At nagpapatrolya sila hanggang sa Batanes, sa Nueva Ecija, and parts of the South China Sea, using Lalo as their operating base.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, magkakaroon kayo ng launch doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang U.S. military sa proyektong ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Wala pong anumang involvement, yun po ang sinasabi natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At least, nagkaroon tayo ng pagkakataon to publicly discuss ano ba talaga yung plano ng Philippine Space Agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano ba itong binanggit ng Pangulo sa SONA?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At nakikita po natin na, if not now, ay kasama rin po sa proyekto yung mga issue ng national security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At nakikita na rin po natin, kahit pa pano, ay nadidikit sa usapin ng Paxilica at saka ng U.S. military presence ang proyektong ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kaya babantayan po natin ang further developments dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At the same time, of course,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: mahalaga ng mag-develop ng sariling industriya ang mga Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kailangan tiyakin natin na ito ay maglilingkod sa interest ng mga Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And I look forward to further discussions with Philza on this matter.

segments.text: Thank you, Honorable Tinio, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
