segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleagues, CCC family, led by Secretary Robert Borje,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: It is my privilege to sponsor the proposed Fiscal Year 2027 budget of the Climate Change Commission, or CCC.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: The government's lead policy-making body tasked to coordinate, monitor, and evaluate our programs and action plans on climate change

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: and ensure the mainstreaming of climate change into national, sectoral, and local development plans and programs and investment programming.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Climate change is no longer a distant threat.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Intensifying tropical cyclones, sea-level rise, heavy rainfall events, and increasing temperatures already affect the lives and livelihoods of millions of Filipinos.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: From damage to agriculture and infrastructure to escalating economic costs, the burden of climate change continues to grow, falling most heavily on vulnerable communities and sectors.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: This reality underscores the need for sustained and sustainable development.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: The Commission's role is not only to develop climate policies, but to ensure that these are translated into risk-informed planning, investments, and programs that respond to the needs of communities and sectors.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: The CCC also plays an important role in advancing the country's climate finance agenda and in strengthening the use of

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: climate risk information to support evidence-based decision-making.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, the proposed budget of the Commission amounts to Php 183,482,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: It is Php 132,801,000, or 41.99% lower compared to the fiscal year 2026 budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, this budget is not merely an operational expense.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: It is an investment in building more resilient

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: communities, advancing climate-responsive planning, safeguarding infrastructure and livelihoods, and ultimately securing the lives, well-being and sustainable future of every Filipino. I therefore respectfully seek the support of this august chamber for the approval of the fiscal year 2027 budget of the Climate Change Commission. This representation is now ready for interpellation. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Rep. Eduardo R. Rama Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to recognize Representative Iris Marie de Mesa Montes from 4K Partylist.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: The gentlelady from 4K Partylist, Representative Iris Marie de Mesa Montes, ma'am, you are recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. Distinguished sponsor to the Climate Change Commission, pagandang umaga po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ilang katanungan lamang po mula sa kababaihan kabalikatan para sa kapakanan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: At kaularan ng bayan, nabanggit niyo po sa inyong opening statement, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: na the Climate Change Commission was created to lead, coordinate, monitor, and evaluate climate change programs across government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: This is a very powerful mandate, but the question is whether it is being exercised with enough authority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, which agencies, programs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: and climate tag expenditures will be the subject to actual review and monitoring by the Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, as of this moment, we have 202 NGAs, 98 GOCCs, and 119 SUCs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: For instance, if an agency labels a program climate tagged, but it cannot show a clear climate rational or measurable target or credible risk basis,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ano po ang ginagawa ng komisyon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Meron po bang otoridad ng komisyon na i-question or mag-recommend ng revision or i-flag yung mga items na iyon sa Department?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Department of Budget and Management or Kongreso po.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, yan ay part ng Quality Assurance ng Climate Change Commission,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: and meron silang mga reviews, and then if makapasa, ay okay na sila, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Um, ilan po yung na-review exactly? May datos po ba tayo kung ilang mga climate tag programs ang na-review na ng komisyon na-reject or na-correct in recent budget cycle?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, as of the moment, total na NGAs ay 202, ang completed ng process ay 148, with a compliance rate of 73.27%.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: For GOCC, 98 ang total completed CCET process, 57, with a compliance rate of 58.27%.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: With the SUCs, 119. Completed CCET process, 102. Compliance rate of 85.71%, with a total of compliance rate ng 73.27%, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Um, alam naman po natin, isa sa mga problema, actually po pala dalawa, um, dalawa sa pinakamalaking problema natin dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Um, isa na dun po yung institutional order.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Um, paano po kino-coordinate ng komisyon at na-avoid yung institutional overlap ng functions, especially with like DENR, um, with the NDRRM, with the DOF and other agencies na involved din sa climate policy, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, ano po ba talaga, anong role ng komisyon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Sa coordination, what evidence shows that coordination is producing unified action rather than yung fragmentation pong na meron tayo?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, meron namang interagency meetings with the different agencies together with the Commission, Climate Change Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: So, walang overlapping of duties and responsibilities, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Okay, thank you, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Um, pagdating po sa climate finance, this remains as actually...

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Um, sinasabi po nila, um, the absence of a climate finance unit is very challenging, kaya nagkakaroon po tayo ng fragmented, minsan underutilized and difficult to access, particularly for LGUs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Um, wala po kasi tayong centralized institutional mechanism for climate finance, kaya nalilimit yung abilidad ng ating bansa to effectively mobilize...

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ...coordinate and deploy both domestic and international resources.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Um, while the CCC is mandated to coordinate climate policy, it lacks a dedicated operational arm focused exclusively on climate finance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ano po ang posisyon ng CCC on the creation of a climate finance unit under the CCC?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, meron na silang development partners coordinating group para ma-discipline.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Pag-discuss nila doon kung ano yung mga kailangan gawin para sa Climate Change Commission para, once again, ma-disseminate yung mga information at anong mga kailangan gawin, especially with the LGUs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Um, yung pinupunto ko po dito, Mr. Speaker, um, Mr. Sponsor, kasi yung iba po, diba, parang dire-diretsyo, iba-diretsyo na sa LGU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: May fragmentation talaga, halimbawa may financing, diretsyo sa LGU, yung iba-diretsyo dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ...centralized agency who monitors the financing that comes in para magkaroon ng isang comprehensive...

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: or integrated na pagtingin doon sa mga programa o sa mga proyekto na dapat na paprioritize for financing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: How does the Climate Change Commission deal with that problem?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: As I mentioned earlier, Mr. Speaker, because of the interagency meeting, doon nila nabibigay yung mga gusto nila,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: ano mga kailangan na kukuha nila para once again walang overlapping with the different agencies

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: and iba-iba naman yung mga mandates nila with the different agencies, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: How about po, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, yung pag-access ng mga international grants?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ano po ba ang mga challenges or mga balakid sometimes that we are not able to access grants from abroad?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: That remains to be one of the biggest challenges of the Commission, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: is also working hard with the different agencies to be able to access some of the finances, international finances, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Hindi po kaya yung fragmentation na ito is also a contributing factor and our difficulty to access international financing

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: kasi po, di ba, hindi coordinated, hindi integrated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So medyo mas matagal, mas minsan, baka po, nagkakaroon ng pagkakataon na deadline na hindi natin na ibibigay ng dokumento,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Hindi po ba ito isa sa mga dahilan din kung bakit nagkakaroon tayo ng problema doon?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Isa po yan sa mga dahilan, Mr. Speaker, pero the Commission is now working on the capacity building para sa NGAs

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: para ma-improvise, ma-coordinate ang mga different mga agencies, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: And under the Government Optimization Law,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: yung Climate Finance Unit requested to be established, is requested to be established, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: That was my question a while ago, the climate, I asked about your position on creating a Climate Finance Unit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, in fact, I think the answer was you have, there's already a coordinating committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ito pong sinasabing nyo ngayon, ano po yung Climate Finance Unit?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: An existing Climate Finance Unit in the Commission right now?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: It is still a proposal, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So the Commission is supporting the creation of that unit?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: I was leading to that question a while ago, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker. In fact, the Commission is also requesting your support, the support of everybody,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: especially in the 20th Congress, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, I'd like to inform the Sponsor and the CCC that, in fact,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: this representation filed House Bill 8918, creating the Climate Finance Unit in the CCC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Okay. Next question ko naman po, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Nasabi nyo rin po kanina, every year, communities are hit by stronger typhoons, deeper floods, longer dry spells, extreme heat,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: coastal erosion, crop losses, water insecurity, and displacement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Against this backdrop po, how can the Commission justify its 2027 proposal as adequate,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: considering na, sabi nyo rin po, bumaba po yung proposed budget for 2027?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ano po, dito sa funding gap na ito, ano po ang mga maaapektuhan na programa at proyekto ng CCC?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, ang Commission naman ay nag-request na mas mataas na budget, but they also understand the budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Ang maapektuhan ng mga programs nila, a capacity building for LGU, mga data,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: gathering, at sa iba pang mga programs, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Doon sa capacity building po, alam ko isang challenge dyan eh, kaya hindi makapag-access.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Halimbawa nga yung mga LGU sa People's Survival Fund, kasi nahihirapan po sila doon sa documentation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: sa sobrang dami po ng dokumentong hinihingi, ultimo po paggawa ng project proposal, hirap sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So kasama po ba dyan sa capacity building yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: On climate disasters and losses naman po, meron po bang estimate ang Commission yung annual economic and social cost ng climate impact sa Pilipinas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Meron po tayong datos tungkol dyan?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: The Commission has a data, Mr. Speaker, but please allow me to...

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, ang gusto ko lamang po ito nung tungkol dyan, in general, yung data pong yan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: kung lagi po nating pinupondohan lamang yung ating recovery,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: hindi pa kaya dapat mas pagtuuna natin ng pansin yung prevention before disasters?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ganoon naman po ang ginagawa ng Commission, hindi po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, meron naman po and we agree.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: That's why we have the National Adaptation Plan at saka predictive governance of our Honorable President Bongbao Marcos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa mga vulnerable sectors, paano nasisiguro po ng Commission na yung ating mga magsasaka, mangingisda, yung mga informal settler families,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Children, senior citizen, PWDs at mga kababaihan ay hindi lamang mga tinatawag nating generic beneficiaries,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: kundi tinatrato sila na specific groups na may specific climate risk at dapat may specific budget need din na nailalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Meron po ba tayong nakalaan sa pagpupondo ng ganyan sa budget ng 2027?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: In fact, it is included sa NAP localization, saka sa NDC localization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa food and water security, paano nagko-coordinate ang Commission sa agriculture, fisheries, irrigation, water, and LGU para i-address yung mga problema sa tagtuyot, saltwater intrusion, crop failure, fishery decline, water shortages?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: If they are already affecting livelihood and prices, why should climate adaptation remain a peripheral item instead of a central budgetary priority?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Kasama din yung water natin para sa interagency meeting para ma-advance yung national adaptation plan at saka in coordination with the different LGUs.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Meron namang mga series of meetings together with the Commission and the LGUs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Panghuli na lamang po sigurong katanungan on loss and damage.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: What is the Commission doing to help the Philippine access international finance for climate-related losses without creating new debt burdens?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Are we actively preparing project pipelines and evidence-based claims?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Or are we simply waiting for international mechanisms to mature while communities continue to absorb the damage?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: The Commission is currently having a negotiation and kasalipan yan sa development plan ng Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: In closing, the issue before us is not whether climate change is real nor whether the Climate Change Commission has an important mandate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Those questions have already been settled by law, by science, and by the lived experiences of our people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: The issue before Congress is whether the FY2020...

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ...FY2027 budget gives the Commission the resources, discipline, and accountability mechanisms needed to turn climate policy into protection on the ground.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: The KBKP supports the provision of adequate funding for the Commission, but at the same time challenges it to demonstrate that their budget will not merely sustain an office,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: but strengthen the country's capacity to survive.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: adapt and protect the most vulnerable communities from accelerating climate crisis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, and to the Climate Change Commission.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Thank you, Honorable Montez, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eduardo R. Rama Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpolate the sponsor, I move to recognize Representative Renee Louise Co of Kabataan Party List.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: The Honorable Renee Louise Co of Kabataan Party List.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: the sponsor. Ma'am, you have the floor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: to our distinguished sponsor and the

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: we are aware of the existence

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: under Commissioner Albert De La Cruz.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: and mandate of this task force?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: differentiated from that of the CCC?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: different from the Climate Change Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: of any policy directing the Climate Change

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Commission to create or direct such a body.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May we ask if there is

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: a basis for the creation of the task

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: force and how much is allocated

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We'd like to move on to our questions

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: for the Climate Change Expenditure Tagging

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: for this year or for the coming

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, to what extent

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: are tagging their budgets according to

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: meron na mga advantages na naman

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: that CCC is able to do

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: In fact, the Commission has the oversight

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Impact Assessment, as well as the annual

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: in line with our budget season,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, we ask

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: in that way, and that could be seen

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: as an overinflation of how much

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: action, as it does not account

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Last year already and the conclusion was that we arrived at the end was that ideally the mandate of the CCC is expanded so that it is and even it has more authority to be able to do what it does and not just simply be a repository of the tags that each agency is submitting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, for my final question, I'd just like to ask, how well does the Commission coordinate with other government agencies to track and monitor the implementation of climate change programs, activities, and projects?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, it is a part of the interagency meeting that the Commission will conduct with the interagency meeting with the different LGUs and the members of the different agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, if the good sponsor and the Commission can submit a report of how they are conducting these not only capacity building but coordination efforts to ensure that what's in the National Climate Action Program conducts or is reflected in the budget and not simply merely as I've expanded earlier just the

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: discussion of the tags that is submitted by each agency. Would that be possible, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, the Commission will submit the report.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: My final question, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, is that we are aware of a recent statement by the DENR confirming that there is no current environmental impact assessment applied or in process for

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: the Pax Silica Hub, although an environmental compliance certificate had been issued for the BCDA's environmental plan. At the same time, Pax Silica initiatives are being discussed as a major technical hub and effort.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Its future requirements for resources and infrastructure, of course, has potential climate impacts in its geographical location. Considering that there is a statement confirming that there is no environmental impact

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: assessment issued yet, how can the Climate Change Commission ensure that any climate-related appropriations connected to the Pax Silica infrastructure are based on a sufficiently supported assessment of risks, environmental impacts, and adaptation requirements?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Paano po i-ensure ng CCC yung kanilang mandato, exercise, na kung anumang budget ilalaan sa Pax Silica in the future or soon ay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: naaayon sa pag-aaral ng mga risks, impacts, at kung anumang requirements kailangan?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, yan ay mandate ng DENR, but the CCC will just assist, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: How would it assist, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: The CCC will provide a technical assistance, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Technical assistance to clarify, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, kung paano i-ensure na yung appropriations ay may assessment of risks, environmental impacts, at kung anumang?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Ang commission mandato ng CCC, Mr. Speaker, ay sa climate lang, but they will provide a climate lens and a projections, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yes, that is precisely the point being made by this representation, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May bird's eye view ang CCC kung paano ang certain appropriations dapat pong direksyonan para po naaayon sa targets natin to reduce climate change.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May early projections now ang ilang environmental groups that Pax Silica may be detrimental to the environment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And so, up until now, may mga tumututol sa Pax Silica, pero this administration is adamant on ensuring that it is signed in November.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, ano po bang kayang gawin ng Climate Change Commission na kung anumang budget ilalaan dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And beyond technical assistance on budget tagging sa DNR, ay naayon siya sa climate change mitigation targets, etc. na gusto natin gawin naman ng buong pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, ang Climate Change Commission ay mag-assess para sa Pax Silica impacts on climate vulnerability sa NDC and low carbon development. Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May assessment na pong ginawa ang CCC?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Sa preliminary pa sila, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, may we receive a copy of this preliminary assessment by the CCC on Pax Silica?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Yes, the commission will submit, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang huling tanong nga lang po talaga natin ay dahil po, as per the involvement of climate change expenditure tagging, in line with the current budget appropriated for CCC,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: there is almost a 53% difference, specifically, from P316 million to P183 million pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: With this decrease in the budget, how can we ensure that risk assessment would be strictly implemented?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Gaya po nang sa kaso ng Pax Silica.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And paano ba natin magagaranti na effective po ito with regards with its decreased budget, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: The commission would like a higher budget, but because of the budget concerns,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: constraints, kailangan lang nila mag-work kung anong nandyan sa kanila,

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: pero they assure na lahat ng mga kailangan gawin ay magawa ng commission, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Meron po bang functions na siguro mas mahihirapan silang magawa dahil sa decreased budget?

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: More on the capacity building on the different LGUs, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Which is very necessary dahil separate pa po sa national budget, may budget din pong ginagawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At kung hindi po nila alam kung paano budgetan ng naayon sa National Climate Action Plan

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: at paano din pong magtag, mas mahihirapan tayong rumespunde sa climate change.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, this representation joins the different colleagues that have manifested here today

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: na dapat sana mas kaya ng Climate Change Commission yung kanyang gawain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At kung ang increase ng budget ang sana,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: kung saan ang makakapagbigay nito, this representation will move for that at the proper time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: For now, I have no other further questions other than we hope that the report can be submitted

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: kung sana po sa Monday, kung maaari, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Yes, the commission will submit on Monday, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eduardo R. Rama Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpolate the sponsor, I move to recognize representative

segments.speaker: Rep. Eduardo R. Rama Jr.
segments.text: Jernie Jett Nisay of Pusong Pinoy Partylist.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Sponsor, isang katanungan na lamang po bago ho natin i-terminate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, ayon po sa latest pag-asa outlook,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: ang El Niño ay maaaring magpatuloy hanggang first half of 2027

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: at maaaring umabot sa very strong state na maaaring magdulot ng mas matinding init at below normal rainfall

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: sa ilang bahagi ng ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Pero nakita rin po natin nitong mga nakaraang buwan na marami pa rin pong magkaroon ng episodes

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: ng matinding ulan at malalakas na bagyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Sa ganitong pabago-bagong climate conditions, paano po minomonitor ng CCC

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: kung ang mga LGU ay handa sa magkaibang climate risk

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: mula sa water shortage at agricultural losses hanggang sa flooding and storm impacts.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: What the Commission has is the LC-CAP of the different LGUs

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: and the CCC is monitoring kung na-implement na ba ang mga LC-CAPs nila, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. John Geesnell "Baba" Yap
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, LC-CAP means Local Climate Change Action Plan, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: nais ko na lang pong ipahayag ang aking suporta sa Climate Change Commission

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: at sa mahalagang gampanin nila sa paghanda ng ating bansa sa mga epekto ng climate change.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Sa uli, ang climate action ay hindi lamang tungkol sa environmental policies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Direktang nakaka-apekto ito sa pagkain at mga presyo, kabuhayan, kalusugan, tahanan, infrastruktura at siguridad ng ating mga komunidad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Kaya mahalaga ang patuloy na tungkulin ng CCC,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: upang matulungan ng ating mga ahensya, LGUs at mga komunidad na maisalin ang climate policies at risk assessments

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: sa konkretong paghanda at mga programang tumutugon sa mga pangailangan ng mamayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Patuloy nating suportahan ang mga akbang na magpapalakas sa climate resilience ng ating mga komunidad,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: lalo na habang mas magiging hindi inaasahan ang epekto ng matinding init, tagtuyot, malakas na ulan at bagyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jernie Jett V. Nisay
segments.text: In behalf of the minority, I move to terminate the sponsorship and debate of the budget deliberation of the proposed budget of the Climate Change Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eduardo R. Rama Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, on the part of the majority, we join the minority in the motion to terminate the interpolations on the proposed budget

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: There is a joint motion to terminate the interpolation on the proposed budget of the Climate Change Commission.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: Hearing none, the interpolations on the proposed budget of the Climate Change Commission is hereby terminated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to recognize, to consider the proposed budget of the Cultural Center of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: Hearing none, the motion is approved.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, may we acknowledge the presence of the heads and officials of the Cultural Center of the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Chairman Jaime C. Laya, Vice Chairperson Maria Carissa Coscoluela, and President Madam K. C. Tinga.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: We acknowledge the presence of the heads and officials of the Cultural Center of the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: Welcome to the House of Representatives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to recognize Representative Christopher Goh from Isabela.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: Vice Chair Ed Christopher Go is recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I am now ready for interpellation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to recognize Representative Iris Montes from 4K Partylist.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: On behalf of the minority, Mr. Speaker, I move to terminate the budget deliberations of the proposed budget of the Cultural Center of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, on the part of the majority, we join the minority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: In the motion to terminate the interpolations on the proposed budget of the Cultural Center of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: There is a joint motion to terminate the interpolations on the proposed budget of the Cultural Center of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to consider the proposed budget of the Commission on the Filipino Language.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, may we acknowledge the presence of the heads and officials of the Commission on the Filipino Language.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: They are Chairperson-Attorney Marites Barrios-Taran, Commissioner Carmelita Abduman, Commissioner Benjamin Mendilio Jr., and Chief Administrative Officer Salvador Sagadal.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: We acknowledge the presence of the heads and officials of the Commission on the Filipino Language, headed by Chairperson-Attorney Marites Barrios-Taran.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: Welcome to the House of Representatives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to recognize Representative Vice Chair Ed Christopher Go, Vice Chairperson of the Committee on Appropriations, to answer questions on the proposed budget of the Commission on the Filipino Language.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: Honorable Vice Chair Ed Christopher Go is recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, it is my privilege to sponsor the proposed budget of the Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: ng Wikang Filipino for fiscal year 2027. The Komisyon sa Wikang Filipino carries the important mandate of preserving and promoting the Filipino language, as well as our other indigenous languages across the archipelago, languages that embody the soul of our people. The Commission's approved budget allocation for fiscal year 2027 is around 120 million, but the Commission has identified an additional 27.5 million

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: For priority programs which are as follows.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Pagbuo ng otografiya para sa sampung matinding nanganganib na wika, pagtatayo ng limang bantayog wika, and implementation of the Filipino Sign Language Visual Communication Assessment for the Deaf.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, the Commission ng Wikang Filipino wishes that its budget allocation will be augmented for the proper implementation of its priority programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: These programs are important in ensuring that our languages remain alive, accessible, and responsive to the needs of our people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: We are hopeful that the Commission's proposed additional funding will be given great consideration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: We are ready to answer questions. Thank you, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to recognize Representative Renee Louise Co of Kabataan Partylist to interpellate as sponsor on the proposed budget of the Commission on the Filipino Language.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: The Honorable Renee Louise Co is recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And to the Commission ng Wikang Filipino, will the gentleman yield to a couple of questions in relation to the budget of KWF?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. Good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang tatanong natin ay tungkol po sa FSL unit na ginawa sa Commission sa Wikang Filipino, na ang pagbuo nito ay may basihan sa enactment ng Republic Act No. 11106, or the Filipino Sign Language Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: National and Official Sign Language of the country, it is a groundbreaking law even from an international perspective.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: It is also comprehensive in its scope of six language domains of education, justice, health, workplace, media, and all other public transactions, services, and facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: It is likewise an unusual law, which accepts that the visual, spatial language used by Filipinos is true and legitimate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kaya po, ang tanong natin dito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: 3 million per year, more or less?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: kung maaari ay makasumiti po ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: po nila, but then hindi po

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May mga ibang taon po bang may budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kinikilala ng batas ang pangailangan nito pero hindi po napupondohan sa kasaysayan ng pagkakaroon ng ganitong endeavor at ganitong pagkilala

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: yung paano nahahawakan ng mga bata, yung FSL, bilang tool to express themselves.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Magkano naman po ang nakalaan o nakalaan sa kasaysayan sa paggamit ng FSL sa higher education?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Para maka-coordinate ng support for the accessibility needs of deaf youth for college enrollment, especially in SUCs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kasama na rin po yung UP pero ang iba pa rin mga universidad din sana.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Sadly po, Mr. Speaker, wala rin po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Paano naman po ang use of FSL?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: FSL in media, in coordination, monitoring, and overall engagement with the MTRCV, DepEd, and ECCDC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: For example, sa pagbuo ng minimum standards for the National Information and Communication Policy for the Deaf and Filipino Sign Language.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Meron po bang nakalaan ditong pondo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Unfortunately po, Mr. Speaker, wala rin pong nakalagay na budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: But kasama rin po ito sa budget request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Paano naman po kung ang pagpinansa or pagfinans ng National Council for Children's Television para po maging platform ito ng alternative learning systems, lalo na ng mga kabataan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Wala rin po bang pondo dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: So wala rin po, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: This is the case for, for example, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Siguro ang panghuli, Mr. Speaker, for implementation, evaluation of policies and guidelines for the creation of disaster-related advisories, announcements, information campaigns, crisis advisories,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: na sana accessible for deaf viewers, including deaf children, na dahil nga hindi po nila as naririnig yung mga announcements kung ito po ay delivered in teams,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: TV, or in announcements, makikita sana in, na may FSL practitioner gumagawa nito, may nakalaan po bang pondo, may ganoon po bang programa na naginawa ang KWF?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, we agree with you, but ang pinakakasya lang po nila is yung kanilang 3.1 million for all their programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, is this also the case?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: This is for addressing the needs of deaf children and youth in the BARM, historically na bababa talaga yung pondo dito, pero dumadami din po yung poverty incidents, education crisis sa children in BARM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, nakakalungkot na marinig na ganoon po kakaunti ang pondo na hindi po nagagawa yung mga sanang naaabot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ng mga accessibility services na inaasahan natin yung FSL unit ng KWF na makakapagbigay ng serbisyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang huli na lang pong tanong, ano-ano po ba ang mga nagawang programa at aktibitad ng KWF para sa deaf children and youth?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Katuwang ng Council for the Welfare of Children.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, sa kasalukuyan po, meron po silang IAC na regular pong nagmi-meet. And yung funding po na ginagamit dito ay nanggagaling lang din po doon sa 3.1 million na allocation po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sir Speaker, kung maaari na lang po lahat ng mga naibigay na sagot sa atin, pati rin po yung mga aktibidad na para nakasentro sa kabataan at sa bata,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: maibigay bilang report from the KWF sa opisina ng representasyon na ito, sana po sa lunes ay available na para po magamit natin sa mga ating paghahain ng mga requests for additional budget, if any.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At yung sinabi pong wish list, kung pwede rin pong maibigay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa huli, sumusuporta tayo sa paglaan ng sapat na pondo para sa pagpapaunlad ng ating mga wika.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang pambansang wikang Filipino man yan, o ang marami nating wikang katutubo, maging ang Filipino Sign Language.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sana nakikita natin kung paano nagagawa ng KWF yung kanilang mandato sa mga programa

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: na pwede nilang gawin para po maibigay itong mga serbisyo, lalo na po sa mga kabata, ang pinaka-nangangailangan nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We will lobby at the proper time for the increase in the budget of the programs of KWF, especially for our deaf youth and children.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Though, let it be on public record, show na maraming inaasahan sa KWF at marami rin pong hindi nahatid po ito sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, maraming salamat, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, for yielding.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: A few minutes of your time to answer our questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpellate, I move to recognize Representative Antonio Tinio of ACT Teachers Partylist.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: Honorable Antonio Tinio is recognized. To interpellate the sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ilang mga katanungan po tungkol sa budget ng Commission sa Wikang Filipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa budget, sa General Appropriations Bill, nakalagay dito Commission on the Filipino Language.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 115.714 million pesos ang nihinging budget. Napakaliit na budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa isang komisyon na napakahalaga ng mandato, yan ang pagpapaunlad, pagpapalago, pagpapalaganap sa gamit ng Pilipino bilang pambansang wika at mga wikang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang realidad po, isang multilingual na lipunan ng ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: at umaangkop ang mga institusyon ng ating lipunan sa realidad na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Mula sa mga paaralan, sa mass media, at unang-una na ang gobyerno. Multilingual tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, dapat umangkop ang gobyerno at ang budget para dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tingnan po natin yung budget, 115 million pesos, at isa ang programa, Filipino and Other Philippine Languages Development Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pwede po bang paliwanag ng sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano-ano po ba ang mga programa at ano ang ginagawa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nang KWF para isulong ka ang kanyang mandato kaugnay sa wikang Pilipino at mga wika ng Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano-ano yung ginagawa nila under this program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, pagbuo po ng otografiya, pagbuo po ng mga glosaryo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: diksyonaryo, pananaliksik, aral, at sa etno-linguistic communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Anong mga wika po ang sinusuportahan ng Komisyon sa Wikang Pilipino? Aling mga wika yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Meron po tayong 135 po na wika.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Magpakatotoo tayo, hindi natututukan ng KWF ang lahat ng wikang yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, yung mga programa, lalo na para sa proposed budget, ang actual na budget ay 85.3 million pesos lamang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano ang mga kongkretong gagawin yan sa 2027?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, noted on this, we will let the agency submit to the Committee for Media Compliance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Isa po ay buniking binukignon, bukidnon, mahagat, amatikanon, inata, inete, kabalyanon, kaluyanen, karulano, malaynon, at orohanon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, mukhang ang focus po na binabanggit nyo ngayon ay yung mga endangered.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang pinag-protecting na wika, ganun po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Mga wika ng indigenous groups, tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Gusto lang po natin malaman, ano yung particular na budget at programa kung meron man ang Commission sa Wikang Filipino para sa Filipino Sign Language?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, nabanggit po ito ng unang nag-interpelate, si representative ko, nais ko pong banggitin din, kaya po ako nagtatanong dahil isang, ako po ang principal author ng Republic Act 11106, Filipino Sign Language Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At minamandato po doon, ang lead agency dito ay ang Commission sa Wikang Filipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang pondo ng KWF para sa implementasyon ng Filipino Sign Language Act. Kung meron man.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 4.7 million pesos. At para saan po yan? Ano po ang specific na gamit dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang makalit na halaga na po. Para saan po yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: For the interpreting systems po, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Interpreting. So, FSL, Filipino Sign Language Interpreting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sapat na po ba yan? Ang pondo na yan ay sapat na para ma-fulfill ang managin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, hindi po ito sapat. Ang tutuusin. Pero pinakakasa po ng Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hindi sapat. Magkano ang dagdag na kailangan ng FSL?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 27 million ang kailangan. 4 million lang ang nakalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At nagsubmit po ba ang FSL ng Kaukulang Request for Institutional Amendment sa Committee on Appropriations para mapunuan ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, may submission po. So, in other words, maaaring matalakay ito sa iko-convene na BARC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee ng Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, okay. Asahan niyo po na susuportahan po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: For as long as na-submit niyo yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: institutional amendment, ay susuportahan po natin ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Mabanggit ko na rin po na bilang bahagi ng implementation ng Filipino Sign Language Act,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: meron pong dalawang deaf officers ang KWF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero mga job order or contract of service.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama po ba? Do you confirm this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Wala po bang proposal ang KWF para mabigyan ng plantilla positions,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: mag-create ng plantilla positions for the positions of deaf officers?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kailangan. Para ma-implement yung batas, kailangan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, meron po. Kasama po ba dun sa inyong proposal na 27 million ang plantilla positions para sa dalawang ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yes. Okay. So, salamat po kung gayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At asahan po ninyo na susuportahan natin ang mungkahing Institutional Amendments for additional 27 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Napakaliit na halaga na lang po ito para sa Filipino deaf, mga kababayan nating bingi sa buong bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At now, let me move on.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Let me move on to another topic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ito po ay sumulat po sa amin at kahit po sa, alam ko, kahit sa commission kay KWF Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Attorney Marites Barrios-Taran, ang isang professor ng Filipino sa UP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa totoo lang, naging kasamahan ko po sa Departamento ng Filipino at Panitikan ng Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang professor na ito, si Romel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Romel Rodriguez, Professor Romel Rodriguez, omeng.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ilala ko po siya bilang omeng dahil matagal po kaming nagkasama, nagturo kami sa Filipino Department for a long time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Noong 2022, siya po ay author ng manuskritong kalatas, mga kwentong bayan at kwentong buhay na ginawa sa ilalim ng KWF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero noong Agosto 2022, naglabas po ng memo, ang KWF, tinawag na subersibo at may red tagging pa sa author at sa akdang ito, kasama ng iba pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So total limang authors at mga akda nila ang dineklarang subersibo ng KWF, kaya pinigilan ang paglabas, ang publication.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Subsequently, naging issue po, dinala po kahit dito sa Kongreso during the budget deliberations, at winit draw yung memo na iyon ng KWF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Gayunpaman, mula noon, 2022 hanggang ngayon, ay hindi na nalabas yung libro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ngayon, ang isang author po na ito, si omeng, si Professor Romel Rodriguez, ay nagtatanong po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ito po natin, si Professor Rodriguez, alam natin, isa sa mga batikang manunulat, awarded, at scholar, scholar, talag-tunay, genuine scholar, tagapagsulong ng wikang Filipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So ngayon, nag-aapila po siya. Ano na nangyari sa kanyang libro, bakit hindi pa rin nilalabas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And in fact, humihingi po ng dialogue with the KWF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Meron po bang update ang komisyon sa kasong ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Bakit nakaipit pa rin yung libro?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano ito? Hindi katanggap-tanggap. Kaya nga pinabawi yung memo eh, dahil censorship po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And red tagging, wala namang basis para tawaging subersibo o red tagging.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang akda, red tag, ang akda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, KWF will act on this after going through the ISO.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: And Mr. Speaker, kaisa niyo po kami dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: It's just that yung komisyon cannot accept or publish sole authorship even though the author have withdrawn.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ed Christopher S. Go
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, sir, wala po kasi

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: actually naka-address sa chair ng commission

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ng commission, so naka-address po sa chair

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So mukhang gusto talaga noong author

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: apparently, as far as he's concerned,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: hindi niya ma-withdraw, nasa inyo pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang tanong na lang po, willing

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nagahabot po ng justisya para sa kanyang

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yes. Opo. So yan po ang pararating

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: natin sa author na ito. Mas

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: na hindi dapat in the first place

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: tinatapos ko na ang aking interpolation. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Good afternoon. Sorry. Question. Is the good sponsor aware that during the recent haze episode, some parts of the country recorded 24-hour PM2.5 levels of 48 and 46 micrograms per cubic meter on September 1 and 2?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Some parts recorded PM2.5 air quality index.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Readings ranging from 203 to 245 up to approximately 211.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. English Colleague, yung haze na yan, galing yan sa Indonesia. Ang tanging makakatanggal dyan, Mr. Speaker, isang malakas lang na ulan. Iyong ulan na ngayon eh. So ulan na yun. Kalimutan na natin muna yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kung walang ulan, we have to worry.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. I told you. Magdating dyan, magaling talaga si Don Pipito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Follow up. As a brief context, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: These readings are significant because PM2.5 consists of very fine particles that can penetrate deep into the lungs and enter the bloodstream.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Again, to clarify those readings, exceeded the 35 micrograms per cubic meter, 24-hour limits cited by Environmental Management Bureau under DAO 2020-14.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Na ba yun, Mr. Speaker? We are aware of that. 25 micrograms.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pag it subsists for 24 hours, eh kawawa naman tayo dito sa Manila.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: That's why may warning na tayo na habang nandyan yung haze na yan, but the 25 micrograms, eh, only persisted for a while.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: It did not last long. So pagkatapos ng ulan, heavy rain will wipe it out.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: I suppose the rains are welcome in order to answer for your concerns.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I told you, Mr. Speaker, it's good.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Follow-up question, Mr. Speaker, this yung sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Those readings are classified as very unhealthy. Is it true?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And DNR-EMB attributed at least part of this episode to possible transboundary smoke from forests and landfires in Kalimantan, Indonesia.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kalimantan is not so much, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ang sunog talaga sa Indonesia, nagsisimula yan doon.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kasi hanggang ngayon, nagpuputol pa sila ng second growth para magtanim ng klapasawit, yung palm oil.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung ang hangin ngayon papunta rin sa atin, eh talagang magsasaper tayo.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: That's why nga, we are praying always for the rain.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: But your sighting of 25 micrograms, mabigat yun.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Eh, talagang hindi namin pa nandito ang DNR.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: tagdagan natin, nakita mo yung budget ng DNR, napakaliit para sa pag-safeguard ng ating kapaligiran,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: pag ganyan ang nag-persist yan ng dalawang araw, maraming talagang magkakasakit, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And I agree 100% to the distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: My follow-up question, in fact, EMB Region 12 itself acknowledged

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: that at the time, only its Coronadal station could analyze PM 2.5.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Meaning, that similarly elevated pollution in other areas could be difficult to detect or quantify.

segments.text: Meron silang DNR in order to warn our populace.

segments.text: Kung talagang ganyan, pag lumabas ka, eh, maglagay ka na ng maskara.
