segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, the issue presented here

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: is not merely whether DNR can record deteriorating air quality,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: but whether its monitoring network is sufficiently extensive

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and whether dangerous readings actually trigger timely public warnings,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: health coordination, and pollution control measures.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Would the distinguished sponsor agree with me?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: As of 12 o'clock today, yung Kutabato na talagang doon ang malapit masyado pumunta yung haze.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Medyo makakahinga na sila doon ng tama.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Only in Mindanao area, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Aba't in Metro Manila, wala na po.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Wala masyado na ito. The rains will wipe it out.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: That's why we need the rain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: When these thresholds were breached, what specific DNR protocol was activated?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Can the good sponsor please inform us?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: To the specific of the protocol, the date it was activated, the public health advisories issued,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: the LGUs formally noticed, whether DOH was formally noticed,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and whether DNR initiated any action under the Asian Transboundary Haze Mechanism.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ito po ba eh, well coordinated po among our agencies?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Yes, pinapalaganap natin yung information, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: quality monitoring from the 10 in the evening,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Tapos yung mga daily, through daily advisories,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: In connection with this, the NEP sets a 2027 target of 80% of highly urbanized cities

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Within the Ambient Air Quality Guideline Values.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Yung monitoring ng DNR, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, ambient lang, meaning to say, outside lang talaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, can you explain what's this 80% compliance means?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: That is, how many highly urbanized cities and major urban centers are covered by this indicator?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How many cities does 80% actually represent?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And which cities failed the standard in the latest complete reporting year?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, hindi pa sila nakaka-100% pero information, 70% pa lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Which cities po ang hindi pa failed po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Do you have the cities who failed this test?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: As far as the monitoring, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, yung kanilang mga monitoring aparatos, okay naman yun.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kaya lang, siyempre, they cannot be present everywhere.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: At saka yung haze, we cannot determine.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: It depends kung alin ang umiiral na hangin, habagat ba o amihan ba.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Before the end of the month, titira na yung amihan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Doon na naman sa amin, sa Palawan, dadalhin yung haze.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Mabuti na lang, meron kami arplano sa Palawan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kaya, nandito sa Kongreso, walang masyadong haze dito, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Now, let me go to water resources, resource issues.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Can the good sponsor confirm that the Angat Dam fell into its minimum operating level this year?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kaya, nagreklamo si Kongresman Bundok na nagbaha doon sa Pampanga.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Dahil doon, hindi mo ba alam yun, Mr. Speaker, Kongres?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, in short, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, hindi pala totoo itong report ko.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kaya nag-alit si Kongresman Bundok dito, nagmamuras.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pinasipay ko lang, huwag ka na mag-alit.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Hindi natin pwedeng pigilin yung ulan, Mr. Speaker, Mr. English Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I was telling you, Mr. Speaker, it's good.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Lastly, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, what reservoir elevation does the government currently target for December 31, 2026?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And what is NWRB's current assessment of the probability or risk category for supply restrictions

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: At least ngayon, Mr. Speaker, Mr. English Colleague, 212 meters para.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: But nung before sa zona, 150 lang yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, in short, Mr. Speaker, during the dry season, that would be suffice?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Hindi naman yung payagan na talagang mag-overflow yun.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Baka sirain pa yung dam na yan. Napakasayang.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Tsaka pag-alita na naman ni Congresswoman Gundok si San Miguel sa airport niya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Distinguished Sponsor, in connection to this, Mr. Speaker, the department's program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: the NWRB Water Resource Vulnerability and Sustainability Assessment Program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: produce science-based information on water availability, water quality, groundwater, and climate risks.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kanyo, kanyo, Mr. Speaker, kanyo, distinguished colleague, yung water quality, yung question mo, kanyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Can you restate the question, please?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: In connection to this, Mr. Speaker, the department's program, the NWRB Water Resources Vulnerability and Sustainability Assessment Program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: produce science-based information on water availability, water quality, groundwater, and climate risks.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Was this the program allocated approximately 137.3 million in 2026?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And how about next year's budget?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Actually, NWRB is requesting for more, but because of the fiscal space, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, medyo nabawasan nga lahat eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, it went down from 137, it went down to 100.6 million?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How come, as we know, DNR is very important and very close to my heart.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How come it was reduced from 137?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: This is true all across the board, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, but yung in particular, NWRB, bumaba talaga from 132, naging 95 na lang, 0.999.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: So, wala tayong magawa kung the executive has mandated everyone to reduce budget.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: They have to live with it.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Maganda sana yung progressive na paket na yung gamit ng pera para matugunan lahat ng pangangailangan, but we have to heed the fiscal restraint.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pati NWRB, bumaba, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, but again, meanwhile, the Water Resources Management Program increases from approximately 20 million to 50 million or 154.5%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Because there's a difference of something like 30 million.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: In the listing, there are water-related projects.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: If I will enumerate, masyadong matagal po ito.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: But, ginawa nalang nila ng paraan, prioritize na lang kung saan nila magagamit yung pondo.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Yung pangangailangan natin doon sa NWRB.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: You mean, Mr. Speaker, order of priority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, again, I think the Water Resources Management Program increases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, mas importante siguro ito ngayon.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kaya nga, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, I really ask your help.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung gusto mo, meron silang request na 668 million additional.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Eh, very major na nga yung budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And we are asking too much from them.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Which activities will not be conducted because of the 36.7 million reduction in vulnerability and sustainability assessment?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How many river basins, aquifers, groundwater assessments?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Vulnerability maps or monitoring activities were programmed under the 2026 level?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And how many will be delivered under the 2027 proposal?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Yung general assessment sa lahat ng mga katubigan natin, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ang hindi nila mapiperforma yun, katulad nung Pampanga Basin na yan, all the way to the north.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Eh, there is no such thing.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Nothing as water as coming from the underground.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Lahat po ng tubig, eh, gagaling yan sa ulan, nag-infiltrate papunta sa baba.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: When there is so much extraction of water from the underground, nagkukulang yun dyan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: So, DNR is mandated to find a way how to recharge it with recharging the underground aquifer,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: whether from the river or from the rain or whatever, at meron silang measurement.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Iyon po ang magsasaper ngayon, that's equivalent to 36 million na tinanggal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Again, I support the budget of the DNR because they're a good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Hindi ko pwedeng tanggiyan, no? Napakagaling.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Not only environmentalist, but it's energy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And of course, to the secretary, you have a good team.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The USEC, the assistant secretaries, look at them, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Of course, Mr. Miguel Labina, their consultant.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Again, for the 2027 budget of the DNR, I fully support po ang budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Dapat dagdagan po natin ito kasi ito po ang ating pinakaimportanteng department.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Thank you very much, Honorable Presley De Jesus.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpolate the sponsor, I move to recognize...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Representative Dadah Kiram Ismula from Partylist, Akbayan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: The gentlelady from Partylist, Akbayan, Representative Dadah Kiram Ismula,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Assalamu alaikum, you may now interpolate our sponsor.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, request permission to speak in the vernacular.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Very short, and if you can, the gentleman from Palawan,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: after you speak, translate in Tagalog or English

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: so that other people present in the plenary will be able to understand.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Problema, Mr. Speaker, bisaya man kami, parehas.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Pasensya na lang. The sponsor and the interpellator are both Bisaya,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: It would be difficult because those who are recording our meeting

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: would be having a hard time because they do not understand bisaya.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Lisod ka ayo i-bisaya kay naka-Englishman ng akong kwestyon, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: para sa aking katanungan, unahin ko ang usapin ng karapatan ng ating mga katutubo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ...projects under the DNR's jurisdiction require free, prior, and informed consent

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: kapag ito ay within or overlaps with an ancestral domain?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Good sponsor, ano po ang examples ng mga projects na kadalasan nangangailangan ng mga FPIC

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung within, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: eh, yung malawakang pagtanim sa dalawang kanti o kansi.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kailangan, unahin mo muna yung isa.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Hindi pwedeng ipagsabay mo yung FPIC sa dalawang magkatabing kansi o kanti.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Para magkaroon ka ng dalawang approval para yung overlapping plantation mo sa...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Limbawa, pagkatanim ng kape dito sa kansi, sa may kansi dito, kumuha mong FPIC ka rin sa kabila.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, yan po ang procedure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Tama po yun, no, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Can the DENR confirm if the 2027 budget includes a specific allocation for FPIC monitoring and enforcement?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: FPIC, hindi DENR ang gumagastos noon.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: NCIP dapat, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pwede sila mag-present kasi sila yung issue ng CADC at saka CADT.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pwede sila mag-present doon kasama ng NCIP.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: But principal, basta may CADC at saka CADT, lalo na overlapping, NCIP talaga yun.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ang DENR observer lang po doon, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So, ibig sabihin po, distinguished sponsor, wala pong nakalaang budget para sa monitoring ng FPIC.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pero yung, if your project is big enough, kailangan ka ng ECC, di ba?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ayun, DENR doon, may budget sila para doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: How much po ang nakalaan para dito sa NEP ng 2027?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pakaliit pa lang nito, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pero, yung AMB, MGV, NWRB, 726 million lang sa 2026, ga-a.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ngayon, we're asking for 816 sa 2027 NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Naka-line item po ba ito o nakapaloob lamang sa general monitoring funds ng DENR?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Nakapaloob, Mr. Speaker, sa general fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kaya ako ito, tinatanong ko, dahil kung walang malinaw na budget line,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: paano po masisiguro ng DENR na ang FPIC ay fully implemented at hindi magiging token ng compliance lamang?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, I will now proceed with the tools na mahalaga para sa environmental oversight naman po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ang Executive Order No. 79, dated July 7 of 2012,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: at Executive Order No. 130, dated April 14 of 2021,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: call for the updating and issuance of updated unified maps of mining areas,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: geohazard areas, protected areas, and watersheds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Naproduce po ba ng DENR ang unified map na ito?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: As distinguished colleague, mayroong updated map by virtue of that Executive Order na laganap po nilang naplane yung tungkol sa MINA at sa mga boundaries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So may unified na map po tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mayroon bang line item din po dito na for 2027 budget sa DENR ang inalocate para naman po makontinue yung unified map na ito at magkano?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ang amount para po magtuloy-tuloy yan, 713 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kung naproduce po ito, nakascade na po ba ito sa mga LGUs para po for their own use?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ah, yung MAPA, nabigyan na yung mga concerned LGUs na po.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Sir Speaker, distinguished colleague. Mayroon, nabigyan po sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, patuloy pa rin ba ang DENR sa pag-supervise ng mine audits?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At kung patuloy pa rin ito, magkano ang budget na nakalaan para dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Under what line item for 2027 budget po?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Hindi ko alam magkano budget po.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Yung strengthening doon sa, ayun, para magpatuloy, maliit man ito, nakakahiya.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: 23 million, baka manipaigo, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, para mapatuloy yung mapping na yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Tingin ko po, ito'y kulang din po, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: para mapagpatuloy nila yung patungkol sa budget na ito para masupervise nila yung pag-audit sa mga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Anyway, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, kaugnay pa rin po sa mining, ano ang status of the mining in Sibuyan Island owned by Altai Minerals Development Corporation, nakarating po sa aking opisina na ito ay temporarily nahinto dahil sa barikada ng mga mamamayan at mismo ang LGU at local residents ang nagpapatawag na i-cancel na ang mining contract.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, di ba yung Sibuyan Island, maliit lang nga yun eh. So dapat talaga i-suspendihin. As of now, suspended yun, Mr. Speaker, I'm distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: May plano po ba ang DNR na i-resume ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hinding-hindi dapat maging kapalit ng mining ang karapatan at mabuting kalagayan ng mga komunidad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ang kahit anong economic activity sa ating bansa ay dapat nakaayon sa utos ng Saligang Batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Na bawat Pilipino ay may karapatan sa isang balanced at healthful ecology.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Sponsor, sa pagsagot sa mga tanong na iyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ngayon po, nais ko naman pong balikan ang issue patungkol sa Financial or Technical Assistance Agreements o FTAA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Noong budget briefing po, na-raise ko ang tungkol sa renewal ng FTAAs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Can the DNR explain their role in the FTAA?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Isa lang, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague. Sa Region 1, yung Altamina Exploration and Resources, Iron Ore, Gold and Vanadium Resources (Philippines), Inc.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Sa MIMAROPA, sa amin, yung Agusan Petroleum and Minerals Corporation, pero hindi pa ito pinayagan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, ano po kaya ang role ng DNR dito sa FTAAs?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Nagmo-monitor lang, Mr. Speaker, ng compliance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kinoconfirm din po sa budget hearing na DNR na merong allocated budget para sa monitoring at enforcement ng FTAAs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Distinguished Sponsor, paano ginagamit ng DNR ang halagang ito para palakasin ang monitoring at enforcement ng FTAAs?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, siyempre, kung may pera sila, they have to travel kasi they cannot do the monitoring dito lang sila sa Manila.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pumunta katulad sa Cebu yan, they have to go there.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Katulad doon sa Humonhon, kailangan pumunta sila doon.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Sa Palawan nga, meron kaming mining moratorium for 50 years, pinirmahan nila.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: So, wala na kaming bagong ina-accept ng mga application.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kaya yung ibang mga probinsya, sabihin mo, Mr. Speaker, gumawa din ng mining moratorium.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Iko-confirm ko lang din po na sakaling may nahuli kayo dito na lumalabag sa FTAAs po during your monitoring, ano po yung ginagawa nila?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung nag-ooperate pa yan, Mr. Speaker, suspended immediately.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pagkatapos, pag nag-violet pa talaga, eh talagang hindi lang suspended.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung hindi naman madala sa multa, eh ang DNR, baka ilibing na lang nila yun doon sa gamitin yung bakho, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Eh, due process pala. I'm sorry.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Hindi pala pwede yung bakho gagamitin doon pag hindi sumunod sa DNR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So, kinakasuhan po natin sakaling lumabag?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Hindi pa talaga pumayag sa multa.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kaya naman, Pilipino citizen, eh alam mo na kung anong parosa, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kasama rin po ba rito ang pagsuri kung compliant ang isang FTAA proposal sa mga requirements

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: gaya ng Environmental Compliance Certificate or FPIC bago ito ma-approve?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Tama, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague. You're very correct.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Na-e-ensure ba ng DNR na ang mga renewal ay di nagiging automatic at sumasailalim pa rin

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, hindi automatic. Talagang ina-isa-isa yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa pag-confirm, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, ngayong araw ko lang po natanggap ang sagot ng DNR

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: hinggil sa FTAA No. 1 ng Oceana Gold Philippines Inc.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: at FTAA No. 2 ng Tampakan Project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ang paliwanag ng DNR ay sa FTAA No. 1,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: walang grave abuse of discretion dahil ito raw ay sumusunod sa intention of the agreement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At ang FTAA No. 2, restoration of the lost term naman daw po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Paano po ito na ipapaliwanag ng DNR sa ating mga lokal, sa ating mga katutubo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Binababaan po ba natin ang ating mga komunidad para sabihin ang ganitong technical na reasoning sa kanila?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Siyempre, Mr. Speaker, unang-una, hirap ka mang pumasok doon kung may mga katutubong nagbabantay.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: So, kailangan kasapin mo yan sila.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Katulad ng Tampakan, eh patagal yan natulog ang Tampakan eh. Ngayon na lang yan tinatampak.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: So, hopefully, if you ask me, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: yung mina hindi naman talagang masama per se.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Basta huwag lang mag-abuso. Lalong-lalo na kung yung nagmimina ay Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ang ayaw natin makita, kung yung nagmimina,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: hindi Pilipino. Dahil ang mina, reserve lang yan, natural resources,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: is reserved only for Pilipino citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: pakiusap naman po at pakisabihan ang DNR,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: hindi pa po nila nabababaan ang komunidad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hindi pa po nila nasasabihan, naa-update sa status.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nagpadala po kayo sa akin ng sulat,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: pero hindi nyo po sinabihan sa baba.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ang LGU lamang po ang sinabihan ninyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: In closing, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: sa usapin ng pagprotekta sa ating kalikasan at pagtanggol sa katutubo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: dapat lang ay hindi nawawalan ng boses at karapatan

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ang ating mga komunidad na direktang apektado.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ang DNR ay hindi Department of Extract Our Natural Resources.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ang DNR ay pinagkatiwala ng taong bayan kasama ang mga katutubong Pilipino

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Distinguished Sponsor, for yielding to my question.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Next time pwede at i-allow nila magbinisaya at nakaka-kapoy kay magtinagalog.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Madam Speaker, next to interpolate the sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: I move to recognize Representative Christopher Sheen Gonzales

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: from the Lone District of Eastern Samar.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Representative Christopher Sheen Gonzales from the Lone District of Eastern Samar

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: is hereby recognized for his interpolation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Madam Speaker, to colleagues and to the good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Magandang hapon po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Will the good sponsor yield for a few questions po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Madam Speaker, nung nakaraang budget briefing sa budget ng Department of Environment and Natural Resources,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: nag-commit ang ahensya particular po ang Mines and Geosciences Bureau na personal napuntahan ang isla ng Humonhon sa giwan Eastern Samar

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: para mag-imbestiga ng mga reported issues and concerns sa ginagawang mining activities po doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, ang question ko po, Madam Speaker, to the good sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: nakapagsagawa po ba ng imbistigasyon ng ahensya sa isla ng Humonhon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Nakapagsagawa po ba ng mga actual inspection ng DENR o MGB sa isla ng Humonhon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ang tanong ko po, alam ko naman na nakita doon ng nag-inspeksyon ng mga taga-DENR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Madam Speaker, kung mapatunayan po na may mga violations ang MPSA o mga nagmimina po doon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: inaasahan po ng representasyong ito na gagawa po ng mga hakbang ang DENR at ang representasyon po ito ay babantayan ang mga pangyayaring ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: So, sa tingin ko po, Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: ang nararapat po ba na sanksyon sa mga nag-iiligal kung meron man po, gagawin po ba ng DENR?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, ito lahat sila sa likod ko nagkocommit sa iyo na pag may mga violation dyan sa mina,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: lalong-lalong na hindi Pilipino yung gumagawa ng mina, eh...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Sobrang sila isandaan dito. They fully commit to support the local.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: During, with regards to the MPSA, during the DENR budget briefing, concerns were raised regarding possible violations of the terms and conditions

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: governing these mining operations in MPSA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: The MPSA itself requires compliance with the Mining Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Its implementing rules, Madam Speaker, approve work programs and other applicable laws.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: DENR, on the other hand, retains regularity, supervisory, and monitoring authority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: maaari po bang mangako ulit ang DENR na ang kanilang isa sa gawa ay comprehensive review ng MPSA na ito, kasama ang lahat ng mga amendments, assignment, operating agreements, at kung nasusunod ba talaga ang mga terms and conditions dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Madam Speaker, to the board sponsor...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, lahat sila nung sa likod ko, in-ok.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Sabi nila, pag ikaw ang nag-lead doon sa inspection team at nakita nila, in spite doon sa mga monitoring nila, kung mayroon pang ibang violation, hindi lang suspension.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung hindi, talagang iteterminate yung pagmimina doon dahil napakaliit nung is lang yan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Nadaan nga ako raw, wala nang matamnan eh, hukay na lang sila ng hukay.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ayaw natin na yung humungun, pareha sa nauru.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Yung nauru, wala nang, wala nang phosphate.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ang mga tao doon ngayon sa Australia na nakatira.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Lihit na lang yung village na naiwan kasi kot-kot sila ng kot-kot.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Naubos yung phosphate doon, wala na silang matirahan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Dati, they were multi, multi-billion island.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ngayon, I was there like 10 years ago.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Naawa ako dahil napakaliit nung isla.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Yung island of Nauru in the Pacific.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Going there, nawala pa kami sa Pasipiko.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Buti na lang naka-landing kami sa Guam.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Madam Speaker and Distinguished Colleague, we will be with you na kung may mga violation yan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Needless to say, hindi lang i-suspend.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Maraming salamat po to the good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Alam niyo po kasi yung isla ng Humonhon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ah, dito po nag-umpisa ang Kristyanismo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Napaka-historic po yung lugar na to.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Kaya sa mga statement po ng ating butihing sponsor, Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: ito po ay nagpapakita sa kaseryosohan na pagmamahal sa mga tao at sa isla ng Humonhon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: At ako po ay nagagalak. Maraming salamat po, ah, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Alam po natin lahat na nangyayaring ito to the DNR family, especially sa ating butihing sekretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Hindi po ito nangyari sa pamumunuan po, sa incumbency niyo po sa ating butihing sekretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ito po ay naman na sa mga nakaraang administrasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ah, gusto ko pong i-highlight yung sinasabi po ng ating good sponsor regarding yung ownership na requirement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Kasi identifying the authorized operator leads us to an even more fundamental issue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Who actually owns and controls the mining operations in Humonhon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: the Constitution requires at least 60% Philippine ownership for corporations entering into production sharing agreement involving our natural resources.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: We have received information that foreign interest, Madam Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Foreign interest may be involved in the ownership, management, or actual operations of certain mining activities in the island of Humonhon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Let me emphasize that we are not presenting this an established fact.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: We are asking the DENR to verify this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: And if I confirm what I am saying, like the stand of our good sponsor, Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: and here comes the DENR's responsibility to answer the violations of mining operators in the island of Humonhon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Can the DENR therefore commit to undertake the necessary verification in coordination with the appropriate agencies to determine kung mga foreign national po ba ito ang nag-ooperate o talagang mga Pilipino 100% ang nag-ooperate.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ang DENR family, we will request them to write to PAOCC, we'll write to NBI, and also Bureau of Immigration.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Para in one sweep, malalaman natin, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, kung meron bang mga foreign interest dito.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Maska reading as Pilipino, ahil napakahirap, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: For Pilipino citizens, only pa. Exclusive, may only pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Kasi alam naman po natin na siyempre dapat makikinabang dito ay Pilipino, hindi mga foreign national.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: My last manifestation, not even a question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Actually, marami naman akong katunungan, pero there's a proper forum.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Anyway, I have a pending resolution para po sa pag-imbestiga ng issue na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Pero ang appeal ko lang po, Madam Speaker, to a good sponsor, ang appeal ko lang po sa DENR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Sana hindi na po humantong sa investigasyon na sinasabi ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ang sabi nyo po kanina, kayo misunod.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ang DENR na mismo ay pumunta na sa isla ng Humonhon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Nakita nyo, sigurado ako, nakita nyo ang mga pangyayaring doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Mga pangyayari na hindi maganda doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: So para sa akin po, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: hindi na paabutin na mabuksan ang imbestigasyon

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: at yung DENR na mismo sa lalong madaling panahon ay maaksyonan ang nararapat po sa isla ng Humonhon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: So, with this, Madam Speaker, to the good sponsor, maraming salamat po sa suporta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: I am doing this, hindi po para sa sarili ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: I am doing this para po sa probinsya ng Eastern Samar at sa mga tao na nasasakupan ko po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: At para sa akin, I will fully support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: With this representation, I will fully support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Maraming salamat po at mabuhay po.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Maraming salamat din, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: And yung mga minanipest mo, I am sure.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: I am one with you and I'll also look after that these promises will be soon implemented.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Madam Speaker, next to interpolate the sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: I move to recognize Representative Sarah Jane I. Elago from Partylist, Gabriela Women's Party.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Representative Sarah Jane Elago of Gabriela Women's Party.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: This is hereby recognized for her interpolation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Una sa lahat, maraming salamat sa mga naisumite na ulat sa representasyon na ito mula sa Gabriela Women's Party.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Tungkol sa mga pangunahing issue na naihapag natin sa harap ng budget briefing ng DENR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nais ko na lang po nasundan ang ilan sa mga hinihingi pa na clarification,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pagpapaliwanag, lalong-lalo na tungkol po sa kapalara ng mga puno sa Marikina City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakaugnay ng ADB Metro Manila Bridges Project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: 23 o 20 puno na puputulin para sa proyekto na iulat ng DPWH sa konsultasyon na labing dalawa rito ang isasalba

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at 8 na i-earthball kahit mga mature ang mga trees na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron na po bang application para sa earthballing permit ang 8 puno na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At napag-aralan po ba ng DENR?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dito sa ulat na ito, tungkol sa kapalara ng mga puno.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, wala pa po ang application, consultation pa lang.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: And I will join you to object pag in-earthball yung napakalaking puno.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Dahil ang earthballing ay pwede lang po yun sa medyo...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: breast height, diameter, 45 cm, and below.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pwede mo earthball yun, Madam Speaker, the Stringis Kulig.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Pero yung akasya na sing tanda ko, e hindi na ma-earthball yun, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Yung 82 years old to 100 years old na akasya, hindi pwede yung earthball, mamamatay.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung maari, palitan na lang yun.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung isang akasya ang putulin na centennial na ang edad, e palitan na lang ng dalawang daang akasya kung saan nila maitanim.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Speaker, ang sabi ng ating distinguished sponsor, may consultation pero wala pang application para sa earthballing permit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maari bang maibahagi ng ating distinguished sponsor kung ano po ang outputs mula sa consultation na ito?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, from 22 trees, e merong 12 na maybe i-allow nila kasi dati.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ah, masi-save pala yung 12 out of the 22.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Consultation pala. Wala pang application to cut.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Speaker, tulad ng nasabi ng ating distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Napakahirap po kung i-earthball pa yung mga mature na mga trees.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po, sinusuportahan natin ang panawagan ng mga residente ng Marikina na isalba ang mga puno na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Bagamat lumiit yung bilang na sinasabi na i-earthball, ay nararapat pa rin na huwag nang aprobahan ng DENR itong earthballing permit

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kung magkakaroon man ng application para sa walong nasabing puno na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago

segments.text: Ipinapakita rin ng mga pag-aaral na mas mataas ang survival rate ng bata o maliit hanggang katamtaman ng mga puno kapag inililipat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mas mahirap din ilipat ang mga malalaki at matatandang puno dahil malalim at malawak ang ugat nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Tulad nga ng halimbawa na naibahagi ng ating distinguished sponsor.

segments.text: Meron na rin tayong mga karanasan noon, Madam Speaker, sa Baguio City, kung saan mahigit 183s ang planong ilipat para bigang daan ang isang mall project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Naaprobahan ito ng DENR, ngunit tuluyan ding naipahinto ng Supreme Court noong parehong taon, bagamat merong ilang puno na naputol bago ang ruling.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa Cebu naman, nasa 228 trees ang nailipat noong 2023.

segments.text: Rapid Transit Project, gayon man, naiulat na may mga punong hindi nakaligtas sa parehong pagkakataon.

segments.text: Doon man sa Baguio, ata meron din po sa Cebu na hindi na nakaligtas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nananawagan tayo, Madam Speaker, na hindi dapat maging kapalit ang mga proyektong pang-infrastruktura, ang pagkasira ng kalikasan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sinusuportahan natin ang mga proyekto na pangkaunlaran, ngunit hindi dapat maisakripisyon.

segments.text: May mga pagtutol din ang mga residente ng Provident Villages hinggil sa ADB Metro Manila Bridges Project.

segments.text: Sa katunayan, nagsasagawa po sila ngayon ng Stations of the Cross bilang pagtutol sa proyektong magdudulot ng pagputol sa ilang matatandang puno sa Marikina.

segments.text: Sa information po ba ng DENR, ito pong consultation ninyo na nabanggit kanina sa Bridge 1 lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakaugnay ng Bridge 2 and 3, nakaugnay ng Metro Manila Bridges Project.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Oo. Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, we are with you in preserving all these malalaking puno.

segments.text: But if the national project like widening of roads will redound to the communities,

segments.text: at saka yun namang malaking puno ay matandang-matanda na, remember, no tree in this planet will survive forever.

segments.text: Mamamatay din yung punong yan. Tulad natin tao, mamamatay din.

segments.text: Kaya, yung DENR naman, kung mas tinitingnan nila na mag-benefit doon yung community sa pagwiding ng road,

segments.text: eh magtanim na lang tayo ng dalawang daang akasya

segments.text: somewhere else para naman yung paligiran at kalikasan may balik mo yung oxygen at saka pag-withdraw ng halaman ng carbon dioxide from the atmosphere at magbuga sila ng oxygen.

segments.text: So kung isang puno lang yun at palitan mo ng isang daan,

segments.text: kung ang kapakanan ay yung carbon dioxide,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: ng halaman at ine-exhale niya oxygen,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: ay mas marami ang benepisyo sa maraming puno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang sulirin natin dito, Madam Speaker,

segments.text: hindi lang isang punong ating pinag-uusapan.

segments.text: na naisumite ng DPWH at ng ADB

segments.text: na kaugnay ng ADB Metro Manila Bridges Project.

segments.text: Ang update nga po dito, dahil very vocal din yung mga residente

segments.text: tungkol sa pagligtas ng mga puno,

segments.text: at may 8 na lang na i-apply for earthballing.

segments.text: Nakita na po ba ng DENR ang pag-aaral na ito?

segments.text: Yung Phase 1 daw at saka Phase 2 at saka Phase 3,

segments.text: Sabi niya sa'yo, ano yung, sorry, club speaker.

segments.text: Saka wala pa rin application eh.

segments.text: Okay, walang application para sa lahat.

segments.text: Pero, itong mga sinasabi na maapektuhang puno,

segments.text: lahat po ito ay parte ng tree inventory ng DENR.

segments.text: Nasa inventory stage pa lang yan sa lahat ng maapektuhang puno,

segments.text: At saka yung importante, yung community consultation,

segments.text: sana nandun ka rin para, madam speaker,

segments.text: para mapagtulungan natin na mabigyan sila ng tamang desisyon

segments.text: na kung ang community magsabi, ay putulin na yan dahil matanda na yan,

segments.text: palitan na lang natin, ay pumayag na tayo.

segments.text: Pero kung ang community mismo mag-resist,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: ayaw nila, gusto nila makitin lang yung karsadang nila,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: so be it, madam speaker, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Diba? Kaysa putulin mo yung 100-year-old, 150-year-old na akasya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Para sa three cutting permits sa Bridge 2 and 3,

segments.text: at wala pang kahit anong application sa ngayon na aaprubahan.

segments.text: Kung gayon, madam speaker, meron na bang environmental impact assessment

segments.text: ang buong ADB Metro Manila Bridges?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Paari ba kaming makahingi ng kopya ngayon?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ang magawa nila, per merong yan, madam speaker, distinguished colleague,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: pwede na nila i-eyeball yun, puntahan nila yun,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Para lang makita nila kung ano yung gagawin nila.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: In the future. So, yung AIS naman, pag meron ng application, bago sila hihingi ng environmental impact study.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero Madam Speaker, kung sa ECC naman, no lahat ito meron ng ECC, ang Bridges 1, 2, and 3.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At maghihingi po ng kopya ang representasyon na ito mula sa Gabriela Women's Park.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: May ECC ba yung pagbutol ng puno?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: O, Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, hindi ko pa alam na meron palang ECC yung pagbutol ng puno.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kasi yung environmental impact study, it will suffice.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Because the AIS will tell you whether an ECC is applicable or not.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, Madam Speaker, kasi ho, kasabi din sa atin ng DPWH nung hinarap natin ang issue na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yes. O, sila kasi yung mag-a-apply.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sinabi nila sa atin na baka yung Bridges 2 ay magkaroon ng pagbabago sa kanilang design.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: O kung saan dadaan ang mga lugar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi meron din mga pagtutol yung mga villages.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang sabi nila, nag-uusap na daw ang DPWH at ang DepDev na magkakaroon ng restructuring sa buong proyekto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang DNR po ba nabalitaan tungkol dito o wala pa sa ngayon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang ngayon naman po sa ibang issue na may kinalaman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang aming opisina ay nakatanggap ng liham mula sa nagkakaisang mamamayan ng Tadlac 1A.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ito po ay naka-address sa Department of Environment and Natural Resources, sa DNR, at sa Laguna Lake Development Authority, sa LLDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang sabi po dito, sila daw po ay humihingi sa inyo ng sertifikasyon, ng klasifikasyon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng lupa para sa kanilang lupa na tinitirhan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil sa ngayon po sa kanila, ito daw po ay itinuturing na domain land at bahagi ng hindi maipagbibiling pampublikong lupa, inalienable public land.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngunit sa ngayon po, meron daw pong nagkiklaim na private owner dun sa kanilang lupa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Natanggap na po ba ito ng LLDA at ng DNR?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Naipadala daw po ito ngayong May 2026.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, tungkol doon sa mga nare-reclaim sa Laguna Lake, alam mo naman, na-diyaryo 'yan lately. May mga concerned high individuals na sangkot diyan. Mahirap na magkomento, ngunit ang DENR mismo nagsasabi ay wala pa silang na-issue na reclamation permit. Wala, walang mga na-issue. Ilegal po 'yun, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang isyo na ito, Madam Speaker, ay meron ng mga pinapalayas na mga magsasaka at naninirahan dun sa lugar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang kwento po nila, noong 1980s, sumubok daw po sila, in early 2000s, na magkaroon ng titulo yung mga lupa na yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngunit ang paliwanag nga sa kanila ay hindi yun pwede matitulohan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po, nabigla po sila ngayon na merong private claimant.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Na hindi po nila kakilala at niminsan ay hindi nila nakita dun sa lugar na nagsasabi na sa kanila daw po yung lupa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, Madam Speaker, ang punto ng liham na ito na is po nilang mag-ocular visit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mag-karoon ng inspeksyon dun sa lugar, ang DNR, ang LLDA, para makita talaga nila yung sitwasyon ng pagpapalayas sa mga magsasaka.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At matiyak natin na mapapangalagaan, hindi lang yung kabuhayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Itong mga magsasaka, kundi matiyak din yung kanilang karapatan sa panirahan sa lupa na kanilang sinasaka o malapit sa kanilang sinasaka.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Madam Speaker, lalo na kung mga illegal yun na pagtambak doon at saka in-occupy ng ating mga kapatid na maralita, magsasaka ito o mangingisda?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mga magsasaka at meron din pong ilan na nagfifish pond.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Sa lupa at saka yung mangingisda sa lawa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Tapos sila daw ay matagal nang nakatira.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Karamihan yan, yung mga illegal tambak dyan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Wala silang, ang DNR wala pa pong pangkalahatang solusyon dyan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Dahil hindi man yan na legal na reclamation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung reclamation na yan na pinadaan sa PRA, na binigyan ng PRA ng permit para, tandaan mo Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: kung ang reclamation sa lawa o sa dagat ay land for the landless, that is permitted.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kaya yung mga maku-occupy doon na kasunod sa pagtambak ng may pahintulot ang PRA ay hindi po yun illegal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon Madam Speaker, wala po itong kahit anong permit mula sa PRA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron pong pribado na pumapasok na gustong magtayo ng resort doon sa lugar at sila ay pinapanayos.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Madam Speaker, ang kalawakan ng tinutukoy mo.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ngunit dyan sa lawa, wala talagang binibigyan ng permit dyan para mag-reclaim.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Except yung mga karsada na gagawin dyan na pinag-aaralan pa hanggang ngayon Madam Speaker, extinguish kulig.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yan nga ang dahilan Madam Speaker kung bakit hiniingin ang representasyon na ito na bisitahin natin yung lugar dito na binabanggit sa Purok 1A, Barangay Tadlac, Los Baños, Laguna.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At para makita po ninyo mismo yung sitwasyon at makita natin, marinig natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Wala doon sa ating mga kababayan mismo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ano ba yung issue? Anong kinakailang aksyon? At paano tayo magtutulungan para matugunan ang kanilang issue?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: I suggest that yung letter mo na yan, iproward mo sa concerned department sa DNR para matugunan ka agad yan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Para alam mo naman ang DNR kung sino yung walang lupa ay binibigyan, hindi yung maraming lupa ang binibigyan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Sinisiguro ko yan Madam Speaker dahil...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Siyempre, the government is there for the side of the landless.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Speaker, just for the record po, when this was sent to the DNR and the LLDA, this representation was furnished with a copy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: And with due diligence, we forwarded the letter to the concerned agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: And then, dahil po ngayon, pinapaabot na po natin ulit at sana maaksyonan ito agad ng LLDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat Madam Speaker. Maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Madam Speaker, extinguish kulig. Please give me a copy of that letter.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: And I assure you, Madam Speaker, gagawa ng aksyon yung mga taga-DNR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Madam Speaker, next to interpolate the sponsor, I move to recognize Representative Rene Louie M. Co. from Kabataan Partylist.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Representative Rene Louie M. Co. from Kabataan Partylist is hereby recognized for her interpolation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Speaker. And good afternoon to our distinguished sponsor and the Department of Environment and Natural Resources.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May the gentleman yield to a couple of questions in relation to the spending of the DNR as planned by fiscal year 2027.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Gladly, Madam Speaker. Extinguish kulig. Go ahead, please.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor. My first question would be in relation to Paxilica.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: This representation is heartened to receive.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: The at least preliminary briefer from the DNR in relation to its findings of Paxilica with the available information.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We'd like to supplement a little further given that we've been asking various agencies what they know of this project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And of course, what we would like to ensure and to clarify dahil nakadulot po ito talaga ng maraming mga tanong, concerns.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa mga mamayan tungkol sa iba't-ibang issues.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero ang pinaka-na-perview naman po ng DNR dito ay yung usaping kalikasan, usaping tubig, usaping lupa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: In the last Committee on Appropriations for DTI meeting, Undersecretary Ridolfo stated that investors are expected to provide their own power and water for the proposed Paxilica development in New Clark City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But contrary to this, the government, through a Malacañang press conference, has publicly assured

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: that the said development will have sufficient water without compromising the supply of surrounding communities. The National Water Resources Board reportedly stated that available sources within the project area can meet the proposed facilities' requirements and that community water needs will remain the priority. BCDA has separately stated that the proposed surface water harvesting system could initially supply up to 120 million liters per day, compared

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: With an estimated Paxilica requirement of approximately 65 to 90 million liters per day, with potential expansion of the system to 300 million liters per day.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So ang pansin po natin, iba-iba yung nire-report sa atin ng iba't-ibang ahensya tungkol sa tubig.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yung una, sige pahala po yung Paxilica na maghanap ng tubig.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Tapos ngayon, meron na pong mga iba't-ibang sources na tinutukoy at may pag-aaral at pag-iimbestiga na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa kung paano ba bibigyan yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So may I ask, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, pwede po bang ipaliwanag ng DENR yung contradictions between the two statements

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: at ikumpirma sa publiko, once and for all, ano po ba ang totoo at established for the sake of public knowledge?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, my favorite topic, Paxilica.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Out of the more than 3,000 hectares na BCDA property,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: dyan sa Northern Luzon, 960 lang yung original na envision for Paxilica.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Yung Paxilica, for the information of everyone, this is just an advanced planning kasi kung mawawala yung Taiwan which has four chips maker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ang isa, TSMC, NVIDA, hindi ko lang matandaan yung dalawa.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung ma-overrun ng China ang Taiwan, ay at least may replacement sila na magpakukunan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Lahat ng ating kabuhayan ngayon ay dependent na po sa chips.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Yung telepono na ginagamit ng ating distinguished colleague, yung telepono ko,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: eh kung wala yung mga chips maker na yan, yung mga drones, yung mga AI instruments,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: halos lahat ng ating future requirements ay magagampanan ng project na yung Paxilica.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Now, if you are so concerned about the water resources in the Philippines, napakarami nating tubig.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Hindi lang natin iniipon yung tubig natin at saka ginagamit.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung mapunta ka sa bayan ng Korea, Madam Speaker, lahat ng ridges doon sa bundok mayroong impounding dam sa baba.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kaya maski abot sila ng limang buwan hanggang anum na buwan na ilin ninyo, ay hindi po sila naubusan ng tubig.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Doon sa atin, sa Central Luzon, napakaraming underground water.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: But if I were the government, I will not allow this kind of project to extract water from the underground aquifer, Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: because the underground aquifer is not an infinite source.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Walang tubig na nanggagaling sa ilalim ng lupa. Lahat yan ay recharged ng rainfall.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Papunta po, nag-infiltrate sa ilalim ng lupa. Kaya na-stack up sila doon sa underground aquifer.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kung marami naman ang extraction natin, makakaroon niya ng mga land subsidence.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kaya dyan sa Northern Luzon, starting from Pampanga up doon sa mga kabundukan sa Sierra Madre, ay maraming tubig dyan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ngunit, that is reserved for the communities.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: If itong Paxilica, if I were the government, they will have to bring their own power.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez

segments.text: Representative Sarah Jane Elago of Gabriela Women's Party-list is hereby recognized to explain her vote. She has three minutes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: This representation from Gabriela, Women's Party, votes no to House Bill No. 9642 or the proposed new Espionage Bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Malawak ang definisyon ng espionage sa ilalim ng Section 5.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa panukalang batas, maaaring ituring na espionage ang mga gawaing sinasabing nagdudulot o maaaring magdulot ng pinsala sa Estado.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Malabo at malawak ang ganitong pamantayan at nagbubukas ito ng possibility na gamitin laban sa lehitimong kritisismo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa ilalim ng seksyong ito, habang buhay na pagkakakulong ng walang benefit of parole at benefits of good conduct time allowance ang parusa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa kasalukuyang kalagayan kung saan ang mga kritiko ng pamahalaan ay nababansagan na terorista,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: napakamapanganib ng isang panukalang batas na maaaring magturing sa paglalabas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Paglalantad ng korupsyon, pagbatiko sa mga palisiya o paglalabas ng impormasyong nasa interes ng publiko bilang isang uri ng quote-unquote injury to the state.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: The bill also expands the definition of critical infrastructure to shield private corporate interest by including telecommunications, energy and food security under the umbrella of espionage protection.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: The bill effectively bans the public from scrutinizing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: The industries that most affect their lives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nagbibigay ang panukala ng mas malawak na kapangyarihan para sa surveillance at pagmonitor ng mga communication at financial transactions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa section 16 at section 17, sa pamamagitan ng pag-bypass sa anti-wiretapping law at pagbibigay ng kapangyarihan sa AMLAC na i-freeze ang mga pondo batay lamang sa hinala,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ginagawa nitong normal ang surveillance, harassment at pag-target sa mga kritiko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maaaring gamitin ang ganitong malawak na kapangyarihan upang matahimik o patahimikin ang mga naglalantad ng katotohanan sa mga katiwalian at umaalma laban sa mga mapanupil at mapang-abuso na palisiya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil dito, ang Gabriela Women's Party ay bumuboto ng no sa House Bill No. 9642.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlyn L. Primicias-Agabas
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move that we recognize Honorable Antonio Tinio of ACT Teachers to explain his vote.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Representative Antonio Tinio of ACT Teachers Party-list is hereby recognized to explain his vote.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: First of all, we note that some effort has been made during the period of amendments,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: effort by the sponsors to introduce certain amendments that would somehow limit the scope of certain provisions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: acknowledging our essential critique that the definitions and the scope and coverage of the bill is so overly broad that it poses threat and danger to the rights and civil liberties of Filipinos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In the name of national security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: However, these amendments have not gone far enough.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, nananatili pa rin po ang masaklaw na coverage ng national security, ng critical infrastructure, ng mga pinagbabawal na acto,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang panukalang batas na ito, lalo na para sa mga kritiko at mga tumututol at lumalaban para sa kanilang karapatan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kaya maaaring gamitin ang panukalang batas na ito bilang isa na namang instrumento, dagdag na instrumento,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: para sa pagsupil ng fundamental rights ng mamamayang Pilipino to free expression, the right to dissent in the name of national security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Katulad din ng anti-terror law at mga kaugnay na batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kaya dahil po rito ay bumuboto tayo ng no sa panukalang batas, an act expanding the coverage of espionage law.
